example: I would like a cup of tea, please.
example_zh: 请给我一杯茶。

example: I invited a few of my friends.
example_zh: 我邀请了几个朋友。

example: No student was able to answer the question.
example_zh: 没有一个学生能回答这个问题。

zh: 副. 大约、四处、在附近；介. 在…周围、大约、有关
example: What about a cold drink?
example_zh: 来杯冷饮怎么样？

zh: 副. 在上面；介. 在上方、超出
example: Above all, I want to see him again.
example_zh: 最重要的是，我想再见到他。

zh: 名. 意外事件、机遇、事故
example: We got involved in a traffic accident.
example_zh: 我们卷入了一起交通事故。

zh: 名. 膳宿、预订铺位、适应性调节
example: The hotel has accommodation for one hundred.
example_zh: 这家酒店可供一百人住宿。

zh: 副. 交叉、到另一边、在对面；介. 越过、穿过、与…相交叉
example: The flower shop is just across the street.
example_zh: 花店就在街对面。

zh: 动. 扮演、装作、行动、表演
example: She acted as if she knew French well.
example_zh: 她表现得好像很懂法语。

zh: 名. 行动、活动、动作；动. 对…起诉
example: The action took place in a mountain village.
example_zh: 这件事发生在一个山村。

example: The office was full of activity all day.
example_zh: 办公室里整天都很忙碌。

example: The actor came out from behind the curtain.
example_zh: 演员从幕布后面走出来。

zh: 副. 事实上、竟然、如今
example: Actually, I didn't know anything about those plans.
example_zh: 其实，我对那些计划一无所知。

example: He ran an ad in the paper.
example_zh: 他在报纸上登了一则广告。

zh: 动. 增加、添加、附带说明、做加法
example: It will not add anything to the situation.
example_zh: 这不会对情况有任何帮助。

example: First find out her name and address.
example_zh: 先弄清楚她的姓名和地址。

zh: 形. 成年的、成熟的；名. 成人、成虫
example: That child talks as if he were an adult.
example_zh: 那个孩子说话像个大人。

zh: 形. 在前的、高级的、先进的
example: The price in January advanced 20% year to year.
example_zh: 一月份的价格比去年同期上涨了20%。

example: I read a book of adventure stories.
example_zh: 我读了一本冒险故事书。

example: There are too many adverts on youtube.
example_zh: YouTube上的广告太多了。

zh: 名. 广告、启事、广告宣传
example: He cut the advertisement out of the newspaper.
example_zh: 他从报纸上剪下了那则广告。

example: You had better ask the doctor for advice.
example_zh: 你最好向医生征求建议。

example: The aeroplane set off early in the morning.
example_zh: 飞机一大早就起飞了。

zh: 形. 害怕的、恐怕的、遗憾的
example: I was almost afraid to talk to you.
example_zh: 我几乎不敢跟你说话。

zh: 副. 后来；介. 在…之后、由于
example: I will see him after I get back.
example_zh: 我回来后就会见他。

example: The meeting began at five in the afternoon.
example_zh: 会议在下午五点开始。

example: I felt very light on my feet afterwards.
example_zh: 之后我感到脚步非常轻快。

zh: 副. 再一次、又、到原处
example: You have made the very same mistake again.
example_zh: 你又犯了完全相同的错误。

example: We watched England play against France.
example_zh: 我们观看了英格兰队对法国队的比赛。

example: I don’t know his age.
example_zh: 我不知道他的年龄。

zh: 形. 老的、陈的、有…岁的
example: He works hard to support his aged mother.
example_zh: 他努力工作来养活年迈的母亲。

example: You only started this job an hour ago.
example_zh: 你一小时前才开始这份工作。

zh: 动. 承认、认定、同意、赞成
example: She agreed with him about the holiday plan.
example_zh: 在度假计划上，她同意他的意见。

example: But for air, all living things would die.
example_zh: 如果没有空气，所有生物都会死。

example: The airport was closed because of the fog.
example_zh: 机场因为大雾关闭了。

example: My alarm clock rings at seven every morning.
example_zh: 我的闹钟每天早上七点响。

example: You should stick those pictures in your album.
example_zh: 你应该把那些照片贴进你的相册里。

zh: 副. 全部、全然；代. 全部
example: All you can do is trust one another.
example_zh: 你们能做的就是互相信任。

example: The shop sells all kinds of fruit.
example_zh: 这家商店卖各种各样的水果。

zh: 动. 允许、同意给予、承认、容许
example: Allow an hour to get to the station.
example_zh: 到车站要预留一个小时。

example: Don't worry, everything will be all right.
example_zh: 别担心，一切都会好的。

zh: 限. 各种各样、形形色色的
example: We saw all sorts of animals at the zoo.
example_zh: 我们在动物园看到了各种各样的动物。

example: She talks about her dog all the time.
example_zh: 她总是谈论她的狗。

example: I was almost run over by a car.
example_zh: 我差点被一辆车撞到。

zh: 形. 孤独的、单独的、独自的；副. 独自地
example: It's because you don't want to be alone.
example_zh: 那是因为你不想一个人待着。

example: We can get along very well without you.
example_zh: 没有你我们也能相处得很好。

example: You may have read this book already.
example_zh: 你可能已经读过这本书了。

example: Alright, Sir. That will pretty much do it.
example_zh: 好的，先生。那样差不多就行了。

example: Not only you but also I was involved.
example_zh: 不仅你，我也牵涉其中。

example: This is always the way it has been.
example_zh: 这一直都是这样。

example: The train leaves at nine a.m.
example_zh: 火车上午九点出发。

example: I was not so much scared as amazed.
example_zh: 与其说我害怕，不如说我惊讶。

example: It is amazing that you won the prize.
example_zh: 你得了奖，真令人惊讶。

example: Don't worry. The ambulance will be here soon.
example_zh: 别担心。救护车很快就到。

example: Mr. Children is very popular among young people.
example_zh: Mr. Children 很受年轻人欢迎。

example: It costs an arm and a leg.
example_zh: 这要花一大笔钱。

example: Oh, my white pants! And they were new.
example_zh: 哦，我的白裤子！它们还是新的。

example: I said nothing, and that made him angry.
example_zh: 我什么也没说，这让他生气了。

example: The lion is called the king of animals.
example_zh: 狮子被称为动物之王。

zh: 代. 又一个、另一个、类似的另一个
example: I told them to send me another ticket.
example_zh: 我叫他们再给我寄一张票。

zh: 名. 答案、回答、回报；动. 回答、反驳、适应、答应
example: Your question is hard for me to answer.
example_zh: 你的问题对我来说很难回答。

example: You are not a child any more.
example_zh: 你不再是个孩子了。

example: It isn't like anybody takes responsibility then anyway.
example_zh: 反正到那时也不会有人承担责任。

example: Having failed four times, he didn't try anymore.
example_zh: 失败了四次之后，他不再尝试了。

example: Anyone with an opinion please raise their hand.
example_zh: 有意见的人请举手。

example: You are welcome to do anything you like.
example_zh: 你想做什么都可以。

example: Anyway, she didn't get what she hoped for.
example_zh: 不管怎样，她没有得到她希望的东西。

example: Curious to say, I didn't find it anywhere.
example_zh: 说来奇怪，我到处都没找到它。

example: There is an apartment house near my house.
example_zh: 我家附近有一栋公寓楼。

example: They live in a tall apartment building near the park.
example_zh: 他们住在公园附近的一栋很高的公寓楼里。

zh: 名. 应用、应用程序、相联并行处理器
example: This app will help you improve your English level.
example_zh: 这个应用程序会帮助你提高英语水平。

example: One of the apples fell to the ground.
example_zh: 其中一个苹果掉到了地上。

zh: 名. 约会、委任的职位、委派
example: You can meet Dr. White only by appointment.
example_zh: 你只能预约才能见到怀特医生。

example: I'm looking forward to seeing you this April.
example_zh: 我期待今年四月见到你。

example: What's going on in that area right now?
example_zh: 那个地区现在发生什么事了？

zh: 名. 手臂、袖子、狭长港湾
example: I think my right arm is broken.
example_zh: 我觉得我的右臂骨折了。

example: He won't let anybody sit in his armchair.
example_zh: 他不让任何人坐他的扶手椅。

zh: 副. 兜着圈子、在附近、到处；介. 包围、在…周围、四处
example: There is a bookstore just around the corner.
example_zh: 拐角处就有一家书店。

example: You had better not start until they arrive.
example_zh: 你最好等他们到了再开始。

zh: 名. 艺术、人文科学、技术
example: Everyone is more or less interested in art.
example_zh: 每个人或多或少都对艺术感兴趣。

example: This article was written by a college professor.
example_zh: 这篇文章是一位大学教授写的。

example: The poor man finally became a great artist.
example_zh: 这个可怜的男人最终成了一名伟大的艺术家。

zh: 连. 当…之时、以…的方式、像…一样；副. 同样地、例如；介. 做为、当作
example: You have the same racket as I have.
example_zh: 你有一个和我一样的球拍。

example: He asked me if I could speak English.
example_zh: 他问我会不会说英语。

example: She works as an assistant to the manager.
example_zh: 她给经理当助理。

example: I like tea, and I like coffee as well.
example_zh: 我喜欢茶，也喜欢咖啡。

zh: 副. 也、还；介. 以及
example: She speaks French as well as English.
example_zh: 她会说英语，也会说法语。

example: Look at me when I talk to you!
example_zh: 我跟你说话的时候看着我！

example: My email address is david@gmail.com.
example_zh: 我的电子邮箱地址是 david@gmail.com。

example: I didn't understand anything at all.
example_zh: 我完全没明白。

zh: 形. 吸引人的、有魅力的
example: The walls are an attractive colour.
example_zh: 墙的颜色很好看。

example: I am going to summer school from August 10.
example_zh: 我从8月10日起去上暑期学校。

example: This doll is a gift from my aunt.
example_zh: 这个娃娃是我阿姨送的礼物。

example: It looks as if autumn is really here.
example_zh: 看起来秋天真的到了。

zh: 形. 可利用的、可获得的、有效的
example: We have little money available for the research.
example_zh: 我们几乎没有钱做这项研究。

example: He’s gone away.
example_zh: 他走了。

zh: 形. 引起敬畏的、可怕的
example: It was awesome to meet you in real life!
example_zh: 在现实生活中见到你真是太棒了！

zh: 形. 可怕的、庄严的、虔敬的
example: It's an awful shame your wife couldn't come.
example_zh: 你妻子不能来真是太遗憾了。

example: Look at a baby sleeping in the bed.
example_zh: 看一个在床上睡觉的婴儿。

zh: 名. 背部、后面；副. 向后地；形. 后面的
example: I'll call them tomorrow when I come back.
example_zh: 我明天回来时给他们打电话。

zh: 名. 远足用的背包、双肩背包、背包
example: She is carrying a backpack on her back.
example_zh: 她背着一个背包。

example: • (be) bad for somebody.
example_zh: • 对某人有害。

zh: 副. 严重地、恶劣地、极度地
example: I am badly in need of your help.
example_zh: 我非常需要你的帮助。

example: I want to learn how to play badminton.
example_zh: 我想学怎么打羽毛球。

example: Someone has left a bag on the bench.
example_zh: 有人把包落在长椅上了。

example: My mother baked a cake for my birthday.
example_zh: 我妈妈为我的生日烤了一个蛋糕。

example: We'll likely go to the ball game tomorrow.
example_zh: 我们明天可能会去看球赛。

example: Our hot-air balloon rose into the sky.
example_zh: 我们的热气球升上了天空。

example: I have never fed my dog a banana.
example_zh: 我从来没给我的狗喂过香蕉。

example: The band are on tour this month.
example_zh: 这个月乐队在巡回演出。

example: I changed my money in the bank.
example_zh: 我在银行换了钱。

example: We had a barbecue in the garden on Saturday.
example_zh: 星期六我们在花园里烧烤。

example: Almost all Japanese boys like to play baseball.
example_zh: 几乎所有日本男孩都喜欢打棒球。

example: She is a member of the basketball club.
example_zh: 她是篮球俱乐部的成员。

example: The boy has a bat under his arm.
example_zh: 那个男孩腋下夹着一根球棒。

example: There's only one bath towel in our bathroom.
example_zh: 我们浴室里只有一条浴巾。

example: Don't forget to pack your bathing suit for the holiday.
example_zh: 别忘了带上你的泳衣去度假。

example: Don't leave the bathroom in such a mess.
example_zh: 别把浴室弄得这么乱。

example: He has the water running in the bathtub.
example_zh: 他让浴缸里的水一直流着。

example: The next day the battery was flat again.
example_zh: 第二天电池又没电了。

example: It would be something I'd have to program.
example_zh: 那将是我必须编程的东西。

example: I am taking a holiday at the beach.
example_zh: 我正在海边度假。

example: A bean can answer all the questions.
example_zh: 一颗豆子能回答所有问题。

example: A bear will not touch a dead body.
example_zh: 熊不会碰尸体。

example: I know that German with a long beard.
example_zh: 我认识那个留长胡子的德国人。

example: To my surprise, he had a beautiful voice.
example_zh: 令我惊讶的是，他有一副好嗓子。

example: You're lucky because he didn't bite you.
example_zh: 你很幸运，因为他没有咬你。

example: The match was cancelled because of the rain.
example_zh: 比赛因为下雨取消了。

example: If you eat too much, you'll become fat.
example_zh: 如果你吃得太多，你会变胖。

example: Sick and tired, she went to bed early.
example_zh: 又病又累，她很早就上床睡觉了。

example: I found myself lying in my bedroom.
example_zh: 我发现自己躺在卧室里。

example: You should pay attention to your well-being.
example_zh: 你应该注意你的健康。

example: Yanni found a June beetle in the backyard.
example_zh: 雅尼在后院发现了一只六月金龟。

zh: 副. 在前；连. 在…之前；介. 在…之前
example: Tell them to call me before they leave.
example_zh: 告诉他们离开前给我打电话。

example: The weather will soon begin to calm down.
example_zh: 天气很快就会开始平静下来。

example: It's dangerous for a beginner to swim here.
example_zh: 对初学者来说，在这里游泳很危险。

example: It's beginning to rain. Please share my umbrella.
example_zh: 开始下雨了，请和我共用我的伞。

zh: 副. 在后地；介. 在…背后
example: He stayed behind in view of possible danger.
example_zh: 考虑到可能有危险，他留在了后面。

example: Whatever you may say, you won't be believed.
example_zh: 无论你说什么，你都不会被相信。

example: You belong in a better place than this.
example_zh: 你属于比这更好的地方。

zh: 副. 在下面；介. 在下面
example: It's below her to say such a thing.
example_zh: 说这种话有失她的身份。

example: I like the one with a white belt.
example_zh: 我喜欢那个带白色腰带的。

example: The cat has just passed by beside me.
example_zh: 那只猫刚刚从我旁边经过。

zh: 形. 最好的；副. 最好地
example: That was the best day of my life.
example_zh: 那是我一生中最好的一天。

zh: 形. 较好的；副. 比较好
example: Now that you are tired, you'd better rest.
example_zh: 既然你累了，你最好休息一下。

example: The church is between my house and yours.
example_zh: 教堂在我家和你家之间。

example: You shall have a bicycle for your birthday.
example_zh: 你过生日时会得到一辆自行车。

example: When we are small, everything seems so big.
example_zh: 我们小的时候，一切看起来都那么大。

example: You're crazy to buy such an expensive bike.
example_zh: 买这么贵的自行车，你真是疯了。

example: Can I have my bill, please?
example_zh: 请给我账单好吗？

zh: 名. (贮存谷物等的)容器、箱子
example: Can you throw the rubbish in the bin?
example_zh: 你能把垃圾扔进垃圾桶吗？

example: He is working in the field of biology.
example_zh: 他在生物学领域工作。

example: I'd rather be a bird than a fish.
example_zh: 我宁愿做鸟也不愿做鱼。

example: This town gave birth to several great men.
example_zh: 这个小镇孕育了几位伟人。

example: It so happens that today is my birthday.
example_zh: 碰巧今天是我的生日。

example: My cat kind of looks like a biscuit.
example_zh: 我的猫有点像一块饼干。

zh: 名. 少量、马嚼子、辅币
example: Let me give you a bit of advice.
example_zh: 让我给你一点建议。

zh: 形. 黑色的；名. 黑色、黑颜料
example: He is the black sheep of the family.
example_zh: 他是家里的害群之马。

example: I found my name written on the blackboard.
example_zh: 我发现我的名字写在黑板上。

example: Cover up the injured man with this blanket.
example_zh: 用这条毯子盖住那个受伤的人。

example: Shall we walk round the block?
example_zh: 我们绕着街区走一圈好吗？

zh: 名. 博客、部落格、网络日志
example: I did the web design for Tom's blog.
example_zh: 我为汤姆的博客做了网页设计。

example: Her hair is blond and her eyes are blue.
example_zh: 她的头发是金色的，眼睛是蓝色的。

example: It made my blood boil to hear that.
example_zh: 听到那件事让我火冒三丈。

example: Could I have this blouse taken in, please?
example_zh: 请把这件女式衬衫改小一点好吗？

zh: 形. 蓝色的、下流的、忧郁的；名. 蓝色
example: The French flag is blue, white and red.
example_zh: 法国国旗是蓝、白、红三色。

example: Dinner will be served on board the plane.
example_zh: 晚餐将在飞机上供应。

zh: 名. 用棋盘玩的游戏
example: We played a board game after dinner.
example_zh: 晚饭后我们玩了一个棋盘游戏。

example: You can hire a boat by the hour.
example_zh: 你可以按小时租船。

example: A model must have an attractive body.
example_zh: 模特必须有吸引人的身材。

example: Boil the news down to a hundred words.
example_zh: 把这条新闻压缩到一百个词。

zh: 形. 煮沸的、(非正式)喝醉的、烧滚的
example: I'd like my egg very, very soft boiled.
example_zh: 我想要我的鸡蛋煮得非常非常嫩。

zh: 名. 书、书籍、帐簿；动. 登记、预订
example: You should by all means read the book.
example_zh: 你一定要读这本书。

example: I can't move this bookcase without your help.
example_zh: 没有你的帮助，我搬不动这个书柜。

example: Carry these books back to the bookshelf.
example_zh: 把这些书搬回书架。

example: She goes to the bookshop once a week.
example_zh: 她每周去一次书店。

example: He bought an English book at a bookstore.
example_zh: 他在一家书店买了一本英语书。

example: You can bet your boots on that.
example_zh: 那件事你可以打包票。

zh: 形. 无聊的、烦人的、无趣的
example: We got a little bored with each other.
example_zh: 我们彼此有点厌倦了。

zh: 形. 烦人的、无聊的、无趣的
example: The game was slow, and it was also boring.
example_zh: 那场比赛节奏很慢，而且也很无聊。

example: The man was ashamed of being born poor.
example_zh: 那个男人因出身贫穷而感到羞愧。

example: She borrowed a book from the library.
example_zh: 她从图书馆借了一本书。

example: You talk as if you were the boss.
example_zh: 你说起话来好像自己是老板一样。

example: Both Tom and Bill are playing tennis now.
example_zh: 汤姆和比尔现在都在打网球。

zh: 动. 烦扰、迷惑、烦恼、操心
example: Do not bother to come to my home.
example_zh: 你不必麻烦来我家。

example: There is a little water in the bottle.
example_zh: 瓶子里有一点水。

example: The bottom has fallen out of the market.
example_zh: 市场已经跌到谷底。

example: The soup in the bowl was very delicious.
example_zh: 碗里的汤非常好喝。

example: I bought a box lunch at the station.
example_zh: 我在车站买了一份盒饭。

example: He is a clever boy, to be sure.
example_zh: 他确实是个聪明的男孩。

example: She is going to part from her boyfriend.
example_zh: 她将要和男朋友分手。

example: This bracelet is more expensive than that one.
example_zh: 这条手链比那条贵。

example: The brain is just a complicated machine.
example_zh: 大脑只是一台复杂的机器。

zh: 形. 勇敢的、美好的、华丽的
example: He was brave in the face of danger.
example_zh: 面对危险时他很勇敢。

example: There is enough bread for all of you.
example_zh: 有足够的面包给你们大家吃。

zh: 名. 休息、中断、破裂处、分隔符；动. 打破、弄破、弄坏、破碎
example: A fire broke out in the neighborhood yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天这个街区发生了一场火灾。

example: The car has broken down.
example_zh: 这辆车抛锚了。

example: We need not have eaten breakfast so early.
example_zh: 我们本来不必这么早吃早饭。

example: The Golden Gate Bridge is made of iron.
example_zh: 金门大桥是用铁建成的。

zh: 形. 明亮的、聪明的、鲜明的
example: It was a bright and clear Sunday morning.
example_zh: 那是一个明亮又晴朗的星期天早晨。

zh: 形. 光辉的、灿烂的、有才气的
example: I thought the film was brilliant!
example_zh: 我觉得这部电影非常棒！

zh: 动. 带来、产生、促使、生产
example: Hard work has brought him where he is.
example_zh: 努力工作让他有了今天的成就。

zh: 动. 拿回来、使回忆起来、使恢复
example: Please bring back the book when you finish it.
example_zh: 你读完这本书后请把它还回来。

zh: 形. 坏掉的、打破的、断掉的
example: I can't walk because of my broken leg.
example_zh: 我的腿断了，所以不能走路。

example: The boy singing a song is my brother.
example_zh: 正在唱歌的那个男孩是我弟弟。

zh: 形. 褐色的；名. 褐色
example: The woman on the bench is Mrs. Brown.
example_zh: 长椅上的那位女士是布朗太太。

zh: 名. 刷子、毛笔、争吵；动. 刷、擦过、掠过
example: This shampoo comes with a nice hair brush.
example_zh: 这款洗发水附赠一把漂亮的发刷。

example: The building on the hill is our school.
example_zh: 山上的那栋建筑是我们的学校。

example: Look at that building standing on the hill.
example_zh: 看那座立在山上的建筑物。

example: I ate a burger, then went to bed.
example_zh: 我吃了一个汉堡，然后就去睡觉了。

example: Hurry up, and you can catch the bus.
example_zh: 快点，这样你就能赶上公共汽车。

example: You have no business complaining about the matter.
example_zh: 你没有资格抱怨这件事。

zh: 名. 商人、实业家、工商业家
example: As a businessman he is far above me.
example_zh: 作为一名商人，他比我强多了。

zh: 名. 商人、办理实务的人、经商者
example: Skura is a wealthy businesswoman from Algeria.
example_zh: 斯库拉是一位来自阿尔及利亚的富有女商人。

example: Her father is a busy business person in the city.
example_zh: 她父亲是城里一位忙碌的生意人。

example: The bus station is next to the shopping centre.
example_zh: 公共汽车站就在购物中心旁边。

example: I wait for the bus at the bus stop near my house.
example_zh: 我在我家附近的公交车站等公共汽车。

zh: 形. 忙碌的、热闹的、没空的
example: You are always as busy as a bee.
example_zh: 你总是像蜜蜂一样忙碌。

example: I'd be unhappy, but I wouldn't kill myself.
example_zh: 我会不开心，但我不会自杀。

example: Cheese and butter are products made from milk.
example_zh: 奶酪和黄油是用牛奶制成的产品。

example: He happened to catch sight of a rare butterfly.
example_zh: 他碰巧看见了一只稀有的蝴蝶。

example: Show me the doll that you bought yesterday.
example_zh: 给我看看你昨天买的那个娃娃。

example: You must be at the station by 5 o'clock.
example_zh: 你必须在5点之前到达车站。

example: I found your keys by accident in the kitchen.
example_zh: 我在厨房里偶然找到了你的钥匙。

example: By the way, did you finish your homework?
example_zh: 顺便问一下，你做完作业了吗？

zh: 介. 经邮局、通过邮寄
example: I sent the letter by post yesterday.
example_zh: 我昨天把信邮寄出去了。

zh: 叹. interj. 再会、回头见
example: It is high time we said good-bye.
example_zh: 我们该说再见了。

example: The Cabinet conference was all but over then.
example_zh: 那时内阁会议差不多结束了。

example: We had lunch in a small cafe near the river.
example_zh: 我们在河边的一家小咖啡馆吃了午饭。

example: A cafeteria is a self-service style restaurant.
example_zh: 自助餐厅是一种自助式餐厅。

example: You can have any cake on the table.
example_zh: 你可以吃桌子上的任何一块蛋糕。

example: January is the first month of the calendar.
example_zh: 一月是日历上的第一个月。

zh: 名. 呼叫、访问、打电话；动. 呼叫、召集、打电话、叫喊
example: I’ll call (phone) again later this afternoon.
example_zh: 我今天下午晚些时候会再打电话。

example: Our journey by camel was quite an experience.
example_zh: 我们骑骆驼的旅程真是一次特别的经历。

zh: 名. 照相机、摄影机、密谈室
example: This is the same camera that he lost.
example_zh: 这就是他丢的那台相机。

zh: 动. 使扎营、露营、扎营
example: I would like to join the summer camp.
example_zh: 我想参加夏令营。

example: Camping is impossible where there is no water.
example_zh: 在没有水的地方不可能露营。

example: We should probably head back to the campsite.
example_zh: 我们也许该回营地了。

example: I put on my cap to go out.
example_zh: 我戴上帽子出门。

zh: 名. 首都、大写字母、资本
example: What is the capital of the United States?
example_zh: 美国的首都是什么？

zh: 名. 罐头、容器；助. 能、可以
example: I can ride a bike. (ability).
example_zh: 我会骑自行车。（能力）

example: My son took a candy from the box.
example_zh: 我儿子从盒子里拿了一颗糖。

example: He looks young. He cannot be older than I.
example_zh: 他看起来年轻。他不可能比我大。

example: You are asking too much for this car.
example_zh: 这辆车你要价太高了。

zh: 名. 卡片、纸牌、节目单
example: Let me tell you your fortune with cards.
example_zh: 让我用牌给你算命。

example: Which comes first, your career or your family?
example_zh: 你的事业和家庭，哪个排在第一位？

example: You cannot be too careful when you drive.
example_zh: 开车时你再小心也不为过。

example: Listen carefully, or you'll miss what he says.
example_zh: 仔细听，否则你会错过他说的话。

example: I last saw him in the car park.
example_zh: 我最后一次见到他是在停车场。

example: This carpet is one of the most beautiful.
example_zh: 这块地毯是最漂亮的地毯之一。

example: The hare stole a carrot from the garden.
example_zh: 野兔从花园里偷了一根胡萝卜。

zh: 动. 携带、运送、支持、被携带
example: You should carry out the plan on schedule.
example_zh: 你应该按期执行这个计划。

example: I borrowed this cartoon from his older sister.
example_zh: 我从他姐姐那里借了这本漫画。

example: Take this medicine in case you get sick.
example_zh: 吃这个药，以防你生病。

zh: 名. 现金；动. 兑现
example: The bank will cash your fifty dollar check.
example_zh: 银行会给你兑现这张五十美元的支票。

zh: 名. 城堡、象棋中的车
example: The town is famous for its old castle.
example_zh: 这个镇因它的古老城堡而闻名。

example: A cat got out from under the car.
example_zh: 一只猫从车底下钻了出来。

zh: 动. 捕捉、赶上、感染、抓住
example: If you hurry, you'll catch up with him.
example_zh: 如果你快点，就会追上他。

zh: 名. 镭射碟、镭射唱片
example: Which CD do you want to listen to?
example_zh: 你想听哪张CD？

zh: 名. 激光唱机、CD播放器
example: My car is equipped with a CD player.
example_zh: 我的车装有CD播放器。

example: I saw a spider walking on the ceiling.
example_zh: 我看见一只蜘蛛在天花板上爬。

example: Please turn off your cell phone in the library.
example_zh: 在图书馆里请关掉你的手机。

example: It was a party to celebrate her birthday.
example_zh: 那是一个庆祝她生日的聚会。

example: He is something of a celebrity.
example_zh: 他算是个名人。

example: I don't have a cent, let alone a dollar.
example_zh: 我一分钱都没有，更别说一美元了。

zh: 名. 中心、中心点、中锋
example: There is a new sports centre in our town.
example_zh: 我们镇上有一个新的体育中心。

example: The box is thirty centimetres long.
example_zh: 这个盒子长三十厘米。

example: This church was built in the 12th century.
example_zh: 这座教堂建于12世纪。

zh: 名. 谷类食品、谷类植物
example: I have a bowl of cereal every morning.
example_zh: 我每天早上吃一碗麦片。

example: That girl is certainly a hard worker.
example_zh: 那个女孩确实是个很努力的人。

example: She wore a gold chain.
example_zh: 她戴着一条金链子。

zh: 名. 椅子、显要的席位、主席
example: You may sit down in the chair.
example_zh: 你可以坐在椅子上。

zh: 动. 改变、更换、兑换；名. 变化、找回的零钱、找头
example: There is a change of room for this course.
example_zh: 这门课程换教室了。

example: The French are our neighbors across the Channel.
example_zh: 法国人是我们在英吉利海峡对岸的邻居。

example: He was my favourite character in the film.
example_zh: 他是我在这部电影里最喜欢的角色。

example: You must come and have a chat with us.
example_zh: 你一定要来和我们聊聊天。

example: She met many boys in the chatroom.
example_zh: 她在聊天室里遇到了很多男孩。

zh: 形. 便宜的、不值钱的、可鄙的
example: The necklace is cheap at a hundred dollars.
example_zh: 这条项链卖一百美元算便宜。

zh: 动. 检查、阻止、核对、逐项相符
example: We should check the spread of the disease.
example_zh: 我们应该控制这种疾病的传播。

example: I bought some cheese and a little milk.
example_zh: 我买了一些奶酪和一点牛奶。

example: You never told me Tom was a chef.
example_zh: 你从没告诉过我汤姆是厨师。

zh: 名. 药店、药剂师（英式）
example: The duty chemist is open on Sunday morning.
example_zh: 值班药房星期天上午营业。

example: They carried out a new experiment in chemistry.
example_zh: 他们进行了一项新的化学实验。

example: I'm going to cash in my cheque soon.
example_zh: 我很快要去兑现我的支票。

example: I will teach you how to play chess.
example_zh: 我会教你下国际象棋。

example: Roast chicken is one of my favorite dishes.
example_zh: 烤鸡是我最喜欢的菜之一。

zh: 名. 孩子、产物、追随者
example: We searched the woods for the missing child.
example_zh: 我们在树林里搜寻那个失踪的孩子。

example: I cannot mix chilli with my food.
example_zh: 我不能把辣椒混进我的食物里。

example: Not all English people like fish and chips.
example_zh: 不是所有英国人都喜欢炸鱼薯条。

example: Don't you even think of eating my chocolate!
example_zh: 你想都别想吃我的巧克力！

zh: 动. 选择、宁愿、欲、作出选择
example: You may choose either of the two books.
example_zh: 你可以选这两本书中的任何一本。

example: She went to the cinema the other day.
example_zh: 她前几天去了电影院。

zh: 名. 圆周、社交圈、循环
example: We sat around the fire in a circle.
example_zh: 我们围着火坐成一圈。

zh: 名. 马戏团、马戏、竞技场
example: The clown at the circus pleased my children.
example_zh: 马戏团的小丑让我的孩子们很开心。

example: The station is the middle of the city.
example_zh: 车站在市中心。

zh: 名. 市中心、城市商业中心区
example: We went shopping in the city centre.
example_zh: 我们去市中心购物了。

example: Not all the students were present in class.
example_zh: 不是所有学生都来上课了。

zh: 形. 古典的、正统派的、经典的
example: Classical music is not my cup of tea.
example_zh: 古典音乐不是我喜欢的类型。

example: On leaving school, she got married to her classmate.
example_zh: 离开学校后，她就和她的同学结婚了。

example: There is a tall man in the classroom.
example_zh: 教室里有一个高个子男人。

zh: 形. 干净的、清白的、简洁的；动. 清理、使干净、出空、被搞干净
example: Mum, why doesn't Dad clean his own study?
example_zh: 妈妈，为什么爸爸不打扫他自己的书房？

zh: 名. 清洁工人、清洁剂、干洗商
example: The river has become much cleaner than before.
example_zh: 这条河比以前干净多了。

zh: 形. 清楚的、明确的、澄清的
example: It’s not clear to me.
example_zh: 我不太清楚。

example: Speak clearly so that everyone may hear you.
example_zh: 说清楚一点，好让大家都能听见你。

example: Both the boy and the girl are clever.
example_zh: 男孩和女孩都很聪明。

zh: 名. 咔哒声、啪嗒声；动. 使发咔哒声、作咔哒声
example: Click here to go to our website.
example_zh: 点击这里进入我们的网站。

example: A monkey is climbing up a tall tree.
example_zh: 一只猴子正在爬一棵高高的树。

example: I don't like my brother climbing the mountains.
example_zh: 我不喜欢我哥哥爬山。

zh: 名. 时钟、计时器、(袜子上的)绣花边花
example: He took the clock apart just for fun.
example_zh: 他把钟拆开只是为了好玩。

zh: 形. 靠近的、亲近的、亲密的；动. 关、结束、使靠近、关闭
example: Our school is very close to the park.
example_zh: 我们学校离公园很近。

example: Our school is close to the station.
example_zh: 我们学校离车站很近。

zh: 形. 关闭的、限于少数人的
example: He closed the window for fear of rain.
example_zh: 他因为怕下雨关上了窗户。

example: I hung my coat in the hall closet.
example_zh: 我把外套挂在门厅的衣柜里。

example: Maria spends a lot of money on clothes.
example_zh: 玛丽亚花很多钱买衣服。

example: There isn't a single cloud in the sky.
example_zh: 天空中没有一朵云。

zh: 形. 多云的、有愁容的、云的
example: The sky is cloudy and it will rain.
example_zh: 天空多云，要下雨了。

example: Will you dance with me, my little clown?
example_zh: 你愿意和我跳舞吗，我的小丑？

zh: 名. 俱乐部、木棍、球棒
example: I should like to join the cricket club.
example_zh: 我想加入板球俱乐部。

zh: 名. 四轮大马车、教练
example: She liked tennis and became a tennis coach.
example_zh: 她喜欢网球，后来成了网球教练。

example: The button on your coat is coming off.
example_zh: 你外套上的纽扣要掉了。

example: The island lies a mile off the coast.
example_zh: 这座岛位于离海岸一英里处。

example: If your coffee is too strong, add some sugar.
example_zh: 如果你的咖啡太浓，就加些糖。

example: This cola has gone flat and doesn't taste good.
example_zh: 这可乐没气了，味道不好。

zh: 形. 寒冷的、冷淡的、冷静的；名. 感冒、寒冷
example: The cold weather has turned the leaves red.
example_zh: 寒冷的天气使树叶变红了。

example: A colleague has every advantage over me.
example_zh: 一位同事在各方面都比我占优势。

example: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.
example_zh: 开始工作前，先整理一下思路。

example: Our new English teacher is fresh from college.
example_zh: 我们的新英语老师刚从大学毕业。

zh: 名. 颜色、面色、颜料；动. 把…涂上颜色、粉饰、使脸红、变色
example: I don't like the colour of this house.
example_zh: 我不喜欢这所房子的颜色。

example: I need a mirror to comb my hair.
example_zh: 我需要一面镜子来梳头。

example: You ought to have come to our party.
example_zh: 你本应该来参加我们的聚会的。

zh: 动. 回来、在记忆中重现、复辟
example: We came back from our holiday yesterday.
example_zh: 我们昨天度假回来了。

zh: 名. 喜剧、有趣的事情
example: We went to see a comedy in London.
example_zh: 我们去伦敦看了一部喜剧。

example: Sit on the sofa and make yourself comfortable.
example_zh: 坐在沙发上，随便一点。

zh: 名. 连环漫画、喜剧演员、滑稽的人
example: I gave her a comic book to read.
example_zh: 我给了她一本漫画书看。

example: You had better not keep company with him.
example_zh: 你最好别和他交往。

example: Competition is neither good nor evil in itself.
example_zh: 竞争本身既不好也不坏。

zh: 动. 完成、完工、使圆满
example: Do your best to complete the work.
example_zh: 尽你最大努力完成这项工作。

zh: 名. 电脑、电子计算机
example: I'd like some information about your new computers.
example_zh: 我想了解一些关于你们新电脑的信息。

zh: 名. 音乐会、和声、一致
example: The excited audience ran into the concert hall.
example_zh: 兴奋的观众跑进了音乐厅。

example: Congratulations! You passed the exam.
example_zh: 恭喜！你考试通过了。

zh: 名. 联系、交际、熟人；动. 使接触、接触、联系
example: At last, we made contact with the police.
example_zh: 最后，我们联系上了警察。

zh: 动. 使继续、使延长、继续、延续
example: I wonder when this program will continue till.
example_zh: 我想知道这个节目会持续到什么时候。

example: I enjoyed the conversation we had this afternoon.
example_zh: 我很喜欢今天下午我们的谈话。

zh: 名. 厨子、厨师；动. 烹调、煮饭、加热、在煮着
example: The cook served the family for many years.
example_zh: 这位厨师为这家人服务了很多年。

zh: 名. 炊事用具、炉灶、锅
example: Neither Tom nor Mary has a rice cooker.
example_zh: 汤姆和玛丽都没有电饭锅。

zh: 名. 曲奇饼干、甜饼干
example: These cookies aren't expensive, but they taste good.
example_zh: 这些饼干不贵，但味道很好。

example: When I came home, he was cooking dinner.
example_zh: 我回家时，他正在做晚饭。

zh: 形. 凉爽的、冷淡的、冷静的
example: That’s a cool bike!
example_zh: 那是一辆很酷的自行车！

example: If it is free, please send me a copy.
example_zh: 如果免费，请寄给我一份。

example: There's a white building just around the corner.
example_zh: 就在拐角处有一栋白色大楼。

example: Your answer to the question is not correct.
example_zh: 你对这个问题的回答不正确。

zh: 名. 代价、价值、费用；动. 使失去、值、使花费、花费
example: The picture you are looking at costs 100,000 yen.
example_zh: 你正在看的那幅画要十万日元。

example: I forgot my swimming costume.
example_zh: 我忘了带我的泳衣。

example: I couldn’t find the information.
example_zh: 我找不到那条信息。

example: Visiting a foreign country must be expensive.
example_zh: 出国旅行一定很贵。

zh: 名. 乡下地方、乡下居民
example: They lived in the countryside during the war.
example_zh: 战争期间他们住在乡下。

example: She'll do it as a matter of course.
example_zh: 她自然会做这件事。

example_zh: 有些人在球场上打网球。

zh: 名. 堂兄弟姊妹、表兄弟姊妹
example: My cousin is having a baby next month.
example_zh: 我的表亲下个月要生孩子了。

zh: 动. 覆盖、掩饰、保护；名. 盖子、封面、藉口
example: I had to cover my eyes.
example_zh: 我不得不捂住眼睛。

example: You cannot sell the cow and drink the milk.
example_zh: 你不能既卖掉奶牛又喝它的奶。

example: I like strawberries and cream.
example_zh: 我喜欢草莓加奶油。

example: I'm just a creature of habit, I guess.
example_zh: 我想我只是个习惯按老规矩做事的人。

example: Can I pay by credit card, please?
example_zh: 请问我可以用信用卡付款吗？

example: Tomorrow I have a cricket match. Wish me luck.
example_zh: 明天我有一场板球比赛。祝我好运。

example: Don't be taken in by her crocodile tears.
example_zh: 不要被她的鳄鱼眼泪骗了。

example: No idea of danger crossed my mind then.
example_zh: 当时我一点也没想到危险。

zh: 名. 横越、横渡、交叉点
example: Avoid crossing this street when it is raining.
example_zh: 下雨时避免过这条街。

example: The excited crowd poured out of the stadium.
example_zh: 兴奋的人群从体育场涌了出来。

example: The front of the bus was not crowded.
example_zh: 公共汽车的前部不拥挤。

zh: 动. 叫喊、大声说、哭出、哭
example: The school is crying out for good teachers.
example_zh: 这所学校急需好老师。

zh: 名. 杯子、茶杯、优胜杯
example: Waiter, please give me a cup of tea.
example_zh: 服务员，请给我一杯茶。

zh: 名. 食橱、碗柜、餐具柜
example: I'm sure the potatoes are in the cupboard.
example_zh: 我肯定土豆在橱柜里。

zh: 名. 咖哩粉、咖哩饭菜
example: The curry rice at this restaurant is delicious.
example_zh: 这家餐厅的咖喱饭很好吃。

example: It happened just when the curtain was falling.
example_zh: 事情就发生在幕布落下的时候。

example: The department store is always packed with customers.
example_zh: 百货商店总是挤满顾客。

example: You'd better have your hair cut at once.
example_zh: 你最好马上去理发。

zh: 动. 使循环、使轮转、循环、轮转
example: You may go cycling if it doesn't rain.
example_zh: 如果不下雨，你可以去骑自行车。

zh: 名. 骑脚踏车兜风、骑脚踏车消遣
example: I will go cycling even if it rains.
example_zh: 即使下雨，我也要去骑自行车。

example: When Dad came home, I was watching TV.
example_zh: 爸爸回家时，我正在看电视。

zh: 形. 每日的、日常的；副. 每日地、日常地
example: I want to learn about American daily life.
example_zh: 我想了解美国人的日常生活。

zh: 名. 跳舞、舞蹈、舞会；动. 跳舞
example: When did you see her dancing with him?
example_zh: 你什么时候看见她和他跳舞的？

zh: 名. 舞蹈演员、跳舞者
example: Before Mary got married, she was a dancer.
example_zh: 玛丽结婚前是一名舞蹈演员。

example: I think I was dancing in my sleep.
example_zh: 我觉得我睡着的时候在跳舞。

example: When they are in danger, they run away.
example_zh: 他们遇到危险时会逃跑。

example: If it gets dangerous, give me a call.
example_zh: 如果情况变得危险，就给我打电话。

zh: 形. 黑暗的、暗的、深色的
example: You should return home before it gets dark.
example_zh: 你应该在天黑前回家。

zh: 名. 日期、约会、枣椰树
example: Let's fix the date for the picnic.
example_zh: 我们把野餐的日期定下来吧。

example: On his return he found her daughter asleep.
example_zh: 他回来时发现她女儿睡着了。

example: You should practice playing the violin every day.
example_zh: 你应该每天练习拉小提琴。

zh: 形. 死的、不活泼的、麻木的
example: Faith which does not doubt is dead faith.
example_zh: 没有怀疑的信仰是死信仰。

zh: 形. 亲爱的、昂贵的、严重的
example: She held on to it for dear life.
example_zh: 她拼命抓住它。

example: December is the last month of the year.
example_zh: 十二月是一年中的最后一个月。

example: Nobody could decide as to what to do.
example_zh: 没有人能决定该做什么。

example: I don't know how deep the lake is.
example_zh: 我不知道这个湖有多深。

example: We all suffer from it to some degree.
example_zh: 我们都在某种程度上受它困扰。

zh: 名. 耽搁、迟滞；动. 耽搁、延迟
example: There will be a delay of two hours.
example_zh: 会延误两个小时。

example: The flight is delayed.
example_zh: 航班延误了。

example: I've never eaten anything as delicious as this.
example_zh: 我从来没吃过这么好吃的东西。

example: We are able to deliver within a week.
example_zh: 我们可以在一周内送达。

example: It happened that her husband was a dentist.
example_zh: 碰巧她丈夫是一名牙医。

example: My mother went shopping at a department store.
example_zh: 我妈妈去百货商店购物了。

example: She bought a new coat at the department store.
example_zh: 她在百货商店买了一件新外套。

example: Can you describe the situation you were in?
example_zh: 你能描述一下你当时所处的情况吗？

zh: 名. 沙漠、应得的赏罚、功劳
example: This is an animal found in that desert.
example_zh: 这是一种在那片沙漠里发现的动物。

example: I can't think about the design any more.
example_zh: 我不能再想这个设计了。

example: The design of the new park looks very good.
example_zh: 新公园的设计看起来非常好。

example: He works in a team that does car design.
example_zh: 他在一个做汽车设计的团队里工作。

example: She drew a simple design for her T-shirt.
example_zh: 她为自己的T恤画了一个简单的图案。

zh: 名. 书桌、办公桌、工作台
example: The money on the desk is not mine.
example_zh: 桌子上的钱不是我的。

example: I'm trying to save room for dessert.
example_zh: 我正在尽量留出肚子吃甜点。

example: Please give me the details of the accident.
example_zh: 请告诉我这起事故的细节。

example: I read a lot in my diary yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天我在日记里读了很多。

example: You should learn how to use your dictionary.
example_zh: 你应该学会如何使用你的词典。

zh: 动. 死、死亡、消逝、平息
example: We die whether we make money or not.
example_zh: 不管我们赚不赚钱，我们都会死。

example: The difference is not so great for me.
example_zh: 对我来说，差别没那么大。

example: Your opinion is far different from mine.
example_zh: 你的观点和我的相差很远。

example: Flying against a strong wind is very difficult.
example_zh: 逆着强风飞行非常困难。

zh: 形. 数字显示的、数字的
example: Digital music is becoming more and more popular.
example_zh: 数字音乐正变得越来越流行。

example: He took photos of the beach with his digital camera.
example_zh: 他用他的数码相机拍了海滩的照片。

example: We eat dinner together in the dining room.
example_zh: 我们在餐厅一起吃饭。

example: You can't be hungry. You've just had dinner.
example_zh: 你不可能饿。你刚吃过晚饭。

example: Dinosaur eggs? Impossible. These animals are already extinct.
example_zh: 恐龙蛋？不可能。这些动物已经灭绝了。

example: My father died before I got my diploma.
example_zh: 我父亲在我拿到文凭之前去世了。

zh: 名. 指示、方向、用法说明书
example: Could you write me directions to the restaurant?
example_zh: 你能给我写去餐厅的路线吗？

example: Don't bring that dirty dog through the kitchen.
example_zh: 不要带那只脏狗穿过厨房。

zh: 名. 夜总会、迪斯科、的士高
example: She kept dancing at the disco all night.
example_zh: 她整夜在迪斯科舞厅跳舞。

example: We have agreed on the rate of discount.
example_zh: 我们已经同意了折扣率。

example: He was a kind man, as I later discovered.
example_zh: 他是个善良的人，这是我后来发现的。

example: The students discussed the plan for many hours.
example_zh: 学生们讨论这个计划了好几个小时。

example: Chicken and chips is my favourite dish.
example_zh: 鸡肉和薯条是我最喜欢的一道菜。

zh: 动. 把…突然伸入、跳水、俯冲、猛冲
example: I learnt to dive at the swimming pool.
example_zh: 我在游泳池学会了跳水。

example: I’ve j oined a diving club.
example_zh: 我加入了一个跳水俱乐部。

example: A Japanese would never do such a thing.
example_zh: 一个日本人绝不会做这种事。

example: The doctor told me to give up smoking.
example_zh: 医生让我戒烟。

example: The document was nowhere to be found.
example_zh: 那份文件哪里都找不到。

example: I met a dog on my way home.
example_zh: 我在回家路上遇到一只狗。

zh: 名. 洋娃娃、无头脑的美丽女人
example: The old man gave her a small doll.
example_zh: 那位老人给了她一个小玩偶。

zh: 名. 美元、元(加、澳等国货币单位)
example: The yen is still low against the dollar.
example_zh: 日元对美元仍然很低。

example: The boy considered the dolphin his best friend.
example_zh: 男孩把那只海豚当作他最好的朋友。

zh: 名. 驴子、笨蛋、顽固者
example: That is not a horse, but a donkey.
example_zh: 那不是马，而是一头驴。

example: No wonder you could not open the door.
example_zh: 难怪你打不开门。

example: The remains of human cities dot the Earth.
example_zh: 人类城市的遗迹散布在地球上。

example: Your book is double the size of mine.
example_zh: 你的书是我的书的两倍大。

zh: 副. 下、下去、降下；介. 往下、沿着
example: Don't set your failure down to bad luck.
example_zh: 不要把你的失败归因于运气不好。

example: I downloaded the songs from the.
example_zh: 我从那个……下载了这些歌曲。

example: I saw them leave the coffee shop downstairs.
example_zh: 我看见他们离开楼下的咖啡店。

example: I came to see Dr. King last year.
example_zh: 我去年来看望金博士。

zh: 动. 拖拉、挨近、领取、拉
example: Some of the students like to draw pictures.
example_zh: 有些学生喜欢画画。

example: I searched the drawer for the key.
example_zh: 我在抽屉里找钥匙。

example: Is this a picture of his own drawing?
example_zh: 这是他自己画的一幅画吗？

zh: 名. 梦、空想、愿望；动. 做梦、想象、梦想
example: Never did I dream of meeting you here.
example_zh: 我做梦也没想到会在这里遇见你。

zh: 名. 服装、覆盖物；动. 给…穿衣、整理、穿着
example: The color ran when the dress was washed.
example_zh: 这条裙子洗的时候掉色了。

zh: 形. 穿好衣服的、打扮好的、去内脏及分割加工好的（特指动物
example: Hurry, you need to get dressed!
example_zh: 快点，你需要穿好衣服！

zh: 名. 饮料、酒；动. 喝、喝酒
example: I went to drink a beer with friends.
example_zh: 我去和朋友们喝了一杯啤酒。

zh: 动. 开车、驱使、推动、猛击
example: I'll teach you how to drive a car.
example_zh: 我会教你怎样开车。

zh: 名. 驾驶员、驱动器、驱动程序
example: The driver turned the wheel to the right.
example_zh: 司机把方向盘向右转。

example: You need a driving licence to drive a car.
example_zh: 你需要驾照才能开车。

zh: 动. 使滴下、放下、丢失、掉下
example: My old friend dropped in at my house.
example_zh: 我的老朋友顺道来我家做客。

example: There used to be a drugstore on that corner.
example_zh: 那个街角以前有一家药店。

example: They usually drum their fingers at red lights.
example_zh: 他们通常在红灯时用手指敲来敲去。

zh: 形. 干的、无酒的、枯燥无味的；动. 把…弄干、变干
example: The dry season there will set in soon.
example_zh: 那里的旱季很快就要开始了。

example: Have you ever walked like a duck?
example_zh: 你曾经像鸭子一样走路吗？

example: He was very happy during his school days.
example_zh: 他学生时代很快乐。

zh: abbr. 数字化视频光盘（Digital Video Disk）
example: We watch movies on the DVD every Saturday night.
example_zh: 我们每周六晚上用DVD看电影。

zh: 名. DVD 播放机、影碟机
example: Never touch the DVD player with wet hands.
example_zh: 千万不要用湿手碰DVD播放机。

example: Each of the students has his own shoes.
example_zh: 每个学生都有自己的鞋。

example: My sister and I help each other with homework.
example_zh: 我和姐姐互相帮助做作业。

example: The eagle had to be fed by hand.
example_zh: 那只鹰不得不由人用手喂。

example: Tell me your story. I am all ears.
example_zh: 告诉我你的故事吧，我洗耳恭听。

zh: 形. 早的、早熟的；副. 很早、初
example: You should start as early as you can.
example_zh: 你应该尽可能早点开始。

example: The more you earn, the more you spend.
example_zh: 你赚得越多，花得越多。

example: I found the earring that you lost.
example_zh: 我找到了你丢的那只耳环。

zh: 副. 容易地、轻易地、流利地
example: Begin with such books as you can easily understand.
example_zh: 从你能轻松读懂的书开始。

zh: 名. 东方、东；形. 东方的、向东的；副. 向东方、朝东方
example: My uncle lives in the east of Spain.
example_zh: 我叔叔住在西班牙东部。

zh: 形. 容易的、缓缓的、舒适的
example: It is easy for you to solve this problem.
example_zh: 对你来说，解决这个问题很容易。

example: You shouldn't have eaten so much ice cream.
example_zh: 你本不该吃那么多冰淇淋。

example: It is about the size of an egg.
example_zh: 它大约有一个鸡蛋那么大。

zh: 形. 电的、导电的、电动的
example: The river furnishes electric power to the town.
example_zh: 这条河为小镇提供电力。

example: What would our lives be like without electricity?
example_zh: 如果没有电，我们的生活会是什么样？

example: This is how they catch an elephant alive.
example_zh: 这就是他们活捉大象的方法。

example: The elevator seems to be out of order.
example_zh: 电梯好像坏了。

example: You seem to be thinking of something else.
example_zh: 你好像在想别的事情。

example: I just wanted to check my email.
example_zh: 我只是想查看一下我的电子邮件。

zh: 形. 空的、空虚的、空腹的
example: My life would be completely empty without you.
example_zh: 没有你，我的生活将完全空虚。

zh: 动. 结束、终结、终止；名. 结束、终点、目标
example: The meeting ended at three in the afternoon.
example_zh: 会议在下午三点结束。

zh: 名. 引擎、发动机、机车
example: There must be something wrong with the engine.
example_zh: 发动机一定出问题了。

example: What made Bill decide to be an engineer?
example_zh: 是什么让比尔决定当工程师的？

example: We have enjoyed peace for more than 40 years.
example_zh: 我们享受和平已经四十多年了。

example: You are now old enough to support yourself.
example_zh: 你现在已经够大了，可以自己养活自己了。

zh: 动. 进入、参加、开始、进去
example: Are you going to enter the poster competition?
example_zh: 你打算参加海报比赛吗？

zh: 名. 入口、进入点、入场
example: To her joy, she passed the entrance examination.
example_zh: 令她高兴的是，她通过了入学考试。

example: Write your name and address on this envelope.
example_zh: 在这个信封上写下你的姓名和地址。

example: Our school is surrounded by a healthy environment.
example_zh: 我们学校周围的环境很健康。

example: You need special equipment to go diving.
example_zh: 潜水需要专门的装备。

example: There is an eraser in your pencil case.
example_zh: 你的铅笔盒里有一块橡皮。

example: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
example_zh: 你尤其不应该空腹喝酒。

zh: 名. 欧元（欧盟的统一货币单位）
example: One euro is one-point-five dollars.
example_zh: 一欧元是一点五美元。

zh: 副. 甚至、实际上、完全
example: I usually take a shower in the evening.
example_zh: 我通常在晚上洗澡。

example: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.
example_zh: 国王明晚将亲自露面。

zh: 名. 事件、结果、事情的进程
example: The Olympic games is a great event.
example_zh: 奥运会是一项盛大的赛事。

example: Did you ever hear the like of it?
example_zh: 你听说过这样的事吗？

example: Every student has free access to the library.
example_zh: 每个学生都可以免费使用图书馆。

example: Everybody was anxious to know what had happened.
example_zh: 大家都急于知道发生了什么。

example: You have as much right as everyone else.
example_zh: 你和其他人一样有同样的权利。

zh: 代. 每件事物、所有事物
example: People who love doubt nothing, or doubt everything.
example_zh: 恋爱中的人要么什么都不怀疑，要么怀疑一切。

example: Everywhere we went, we enjoyed ourselves a lot.
example_zh: 我们所到之处，都玩得很开心。

zh: 副. 确切地、精确地、恰好
example: That is exactly what I wanted to buy.
example_zh: 那正是我想买的东西。

example: I have a maths examination next Monday.
example_zh: 下周一我有一场数学考试。

example: Look at the example first.
example_zh: 先看例子。

zh: 形. 优良的、杰出的、出色的
example: Your report is pretty good, if not excellent.
example_zh: 你的报告相当不错，即使算不上优秀。

zh: 连. 只是；介. 除了…之外、若不是、除非
example: Except for Bill, they were all in time.
example_zh: 除了比尔，他们都准时到了。

zh: 形. 兴奋的、已励磁的、已激发的
example: That was an exciting game. Everybody was excited.
example_zh: 那是一场激动人心的比赛。每个人都很兴奋。

zh: 形. 令人兴奋的、刺激的
example: It is an exciting time of the year.
example_zh: 这是一年中令人兴奋的时期。

zh: 动. 原谅、申辩、做为…的托辞
example: Excuse me for opening your letter by mistake.
example_zh: 请原谅我误开了你的信。

zh: 名. 行使、执行、运动；动. 运用、练习、运动、锻炼
example: He should do more exercise to get fit.
example_zh: 他应该多锻炼来变得健康。

zh: 名. 表现、展览会、展览品
example: The exhibition will be open for another month.
example_zh: 展览还将开放一个月。

example: In case of fire, please use this exit.
example_zh: 如遇火灾，请使用这个出口。

zh: 形. 贵的、奢华的、费用浩大的
example: The shoes you are wearing look rather expensive.
example_zh: 你穿的鞋看起来相当贵。

example: It was a very good experience for him.
example_zh: 这对他来说是一次非常好的经历。

zh: 名. 实验、试验、实验仪器
example: The science experiment was fun.
example_zh: 那个科学实验很有趣。

example: I explained to her what the matter was.
example_zh: 我向她解释了是怎么回事。

example: I would really like to explore this cave.
example_zh: 我真的很想探索这个洞穴。

zh: 名. 探险家、探测者、勘探器
example: This book’s about famous explorers.
example_zh: 这本书讲的是著名探险家。

zh: 形. 熄灭的、灭绝的、耗尽的
example: Once a species goes extinct, it's gone forever.
example_zh: 一个物种一旦灭绝，就永远消失了。

example: Will there be an extra charge for that?
example_zh: 那个要额外收费吗？

example: A person with weak eyes can't see far.
example_zh: 视力弱的人看不远。

example: He remains calm in the face of danger.
example_zh: 面对危险，他保持冷静。

zh: 名. 事实、真实性、真相
example: You need not take account of the fact.
example_zh: 你不必考虑这个事实。

zh: 名. 工厂、产生地、代理店
example: It is the factory my brother works in.
example_zh: 这就是我哥哥工作的那家工厂。

zh: 动. 忘记、使…失望、缺乏、失败
example: You worked hard, or you would have failed.
example_zh: 你当时很努力，否则就会失败。

zh: 形. 公平的、按规则进行的、不好不坏的
example: She has fair hair.
example_zh: 她有一头浅色的头发。

zh: 名. 落下、瀑布、采伐量；动. 倒下、落下、来临
example: in the fall (n) (Am Eng) (Br Eng: autumn).
example_zh: 在秋天（名词）（美式英语）（英式英语：autumn）。

zh: 动. 被…绊倒、意外地从…上跌落、落在…之外
example: Be careful! You can fall over on the ice.
example_zh: 小心！你可能会在冰上摔倒。

example: The whole family set off on the trip.
example_zh: 全家人出发去旅行了。

example: The two sisters became more and more famous.
example_zh: 两姐妹越来越出名了。

example: She’s a football fan.
example_zh: 她是个足球迷。

zh: 形. 奇妙的、稀奇的、空想的
example: In terms of salary, that job is fantastic.
example_zh: 就薪水而言，那份工作好极了。

zh: 副. 甚远地、很、到很深的程度
example: How far is the next garage?
example_zh: 下一个加油站有多远？

example: My uncle has a farm in the village.
example_zh: 我叔叔在村里有一个农场。

example: The old farmer did not pay him much money.
example_zh: 那个老农夫没有给他多少钱。

example: I can play the piano after a fashion.
example_zh: 我钢琴弹得马马虎虎。

zh: 形. 快速的、紧的；副. 很快地、紧紧地、彻底地
example: Walk fast so as to be in time.
example_zh: 走快点，以便准时到达。

example: Fast food is cheap but not very healthy.
example_zh: 快餐便宜，但不太健康。

zh: 形. 肥的、胖的、油腻的
example: Do more exercise, or you'll get too fat.
example_zh: 多做运动，否则你会变得太胖。

example: The doctor advised my father to stop smoking.
example_zh: 医生建议我爸爸戒烟。

example: Her favourite food as a child was pizza.
example_zh: 她小时候最喜欢的食物是披萨。

example: We have a lot of snow in February.
example_zh: 我们这儿二月雪很多。

zh: 动. 感觉、觉得、触摸、有知觉
example: Not feeling well, I stayed home all day.
example_zh: 我感觉不舒服，就在家待了一整天。

example: We must always consider the feelings of others.
example_zh: 我们要始终考虑别人的感受。

example: The university was alive with a festival.
example_zh: 节日让大学里热闹起来。

zh: 形. 很少的、不多的、少数的
example: You must keep quiet for a few days.
example_zh: 你必须保持安静几天。

example: Many scientists are working in this field.
example_zh: 许多科学家在这个领域工作。

zh: 名. 档案、公文箱、文件夹
example: In which folder did you save the file?
example_zh: 你把文件保存在哪个文件夹里了？

zh: 动. 装满、填充、弥漫、充满
example: I'll find someone to fill in for you.
example_zh: 我会找个人代替你。

example: I filled in my name on the paper.
example_zh: 我在纸上填写了我的名字。

zh: 名. 软片、薄膜、胶卷；动. 覆以薄膜、拍摄、生薄膜、拍电影
example: We saw the film and had dinner together.
example_zh: 我们看了那部电影，还一起吃了晚饭。

zh: 形. 最后的、终极的、决定性的
example: The final score of the game was 3 to 1.
example_zh: 比赛的最终比分是3比1。

example: We considered going, but finally decided against it.
example_zh: 我们考虑过要去，但最后决定不去了。

zh: 动. 发现、感到、找到、裁决
example: I found my keys under the sofa.
example_zh: 我在沙发下面找到了我的钥匙。

example: I want to find out more about this school.
example_zh: 我想了解更多关于这所学校的情况。

zh: 形. 好的、晴朗的、健康的
example: It will be fine weather tomorrow, perhaps.
example_zh: 明天也许会是好天气。

zh: 名. 手指、指状物、(手套的)手指部分
example: He stood with his finger in his mouth.
example_zh: 他站着，把手指放在嘴里。

example: I will have finished my homework by Tuesday.
example_zh: 到星期二我就会完成作业了。

example: There was a big fire in my neighborhood.
example_zh: 我家附近发生了一场大火。

zh: 副. 首先、第一、优先；形. 第一的
example: I'll speak to him at the first opportunity.
example_zh: 我一有机会就会和他谈。

example: My first name is Anna and my family name is Smith.
example_zh: 我的名字叫安娜，姓史密斯。

example: First of all, you must wash your hands.
example_zh: 首先，你必须洗手。

zh: 名. 鱼、鱼肉、鱼类；动. 钓、钓鱼、查出、捕鱼
example: How is it going in the fish market?
example_zh: 鱼市场里情况怎么样？

example: Not really. I like hiking better than fishing.
example_zh: 不太喜欢。比起钓鱼，我更喜欢徒步。

zh: 形. 适宜的、对的、准备好的
example: I joined a gym to get fit.
example_zh: 我加入了一家健身房来健身。

zh: 动. 使固定、修理、准备、固定
example: Let's get you fixed up with a drink.
example_zh: 我们来给你弄杯饮料吧。

zh: 名. 扁平物、平面、平地
example: Please drink the beer before it goes flat.
example_zh: 请在啤酒没气之前把它喝掉。

example: I was just in time for the flight.
example_zh: 我刚好赶上航班。

zh: 名. 地板、楼层、底部、地面
example: The bedrooms are on the first floor.
example_zh: 卧室在二楼。

zh: 名. 花、开花植物、精华
example: There is a flower shop near by.
example_zh: 附近有一家花店。

zh: 动. 飞、飞越、使飘扬、飞翔
example: We flew to Paris, where we stayed a week.
example_zh: 我们飞往巴黎，在那里待了一周。

zh: 名. 雾、迷惑、(割后的)最生草
example: London is no longer a city of fog.
example_zh: 伦敦不再是雾都了。

example: It's too foggy. I can't see a thing.
example_zh: 雾太大了。我什么也看不见。

zh: 名. 文件夹、折纸机、折叠式书本
example: I will give you a large folder.
example_zh: 我会给你一个大文件夹。

zh: 动. 跟随、沿行、遵循、接着
example: You may as well follow your father's advice.
example_zh: 你不妨听你爸爸的建议。

example: follow somebody on social media.
example_zh: 在社交媒体上关注某人。

example: We went into a shop to get some food.
example_zh: 我们进了一家商店买些食物。

example: The boy stepped on my foot on purpose.
example_zh: 那个男孩故意踩了我的脚。

example: The football game is now on the air.
example_zh: 足球比赛现在正在播出。

example: My cousin wants to be a football player.
example_zh: 我的表兄弟想当一名足球运动员。

zh: 名. 足球员、足球选手
example: Tom will be a good footballer one day.
example_zh: 汤姆总有一天会成为一名优秀的足球运动员。

example: For some reason I feel more alive at night.
example_zh: 不知为什么，我在晚上感觉更有活力。

example: There is a bike for sale in the shop window.
example_zh: 商店橱窗里有一辆自行车出售。

zh: 形. 外国的、外交的、外省的
example: To speak a foreign language well takes time.
example_zh: 要讲好一门外语需要时间。

example: The boy lost his way in the forest.
example_zh: 那个男孩在森林里迷路了。

example: He will probably forget to return my book.
example_zh: 他可能会忘记还我的书。

zh: 名. 叉子、叉状物、分岔
example: I took the right fork of the road.
example_zh: 我走了右边的那条岔路。

zh: 名. 形状、形体、类型、表单
example: We came together to form a group.
example_zh: 我们聚在一起组成了一个小组。

zh: 形. 自由的、享受政治权力的、允许的；副. 自由地、免费
example: I got a free ticket to the match.
example_zh: 我得到了一张比赛的免费票。

example: I'm going to order some more french fries.
example_zh: 我要再点一些炸薯条。

zh: 形. 新鲜的、新奇的、另外的
example: The river was alive with fresh water fish.
example_zh: 这条河里满是淡水鱼。

example: There is no meat left in the fridge.
example_zh: 冰箱里没有剩下的肉了。

example: I suggest that we go out on Friday.
example_zh: 我建议我们星期五出去。

example: After that English exam, my brain is fried.
example_zh: 那场英语考试之后，我的脑子累坏了。

zh: 名. 朋友、支持者、赞助者
example: It’s easy for her make friends.
example_zh: 她交朋友很容易。

zh: 形. 友好的、亲切的、互助的
example: The girl was friendly with a bright smile.
example_zh: 那个女孩待人友好，笑容灿烂。

zh: 形. 受惊吓的、受惊的、(非正式)害怕…的
example: She was frightened to see the black cat.
example_zh: 她看到那只黑猫很害怕。

example: The boy threw a stone at the frog.
example_zh: 男孩朝青蛙扔了一块石头。

example: Why did you absent yourself from class yesterday?
example_zh: 你昨天为什么缺课？

example: The number of the front desk is No 1.
example_zh: 前台的编号是1号。

example: The tomato is a vegetable, not a fruit.
example_zh: 西红柿是蔬菜，不是水果。

zh: 形. 充满的、完全的、丰富的
example: It has been raining a full five days.
example_zh: 雨已经下了整整五天。

zh: 形. 供娱乐用的；名. 乐趣、玩笑、娱乐
example: It's easier to have fun than to work.
example_zh: 玩比干活容易。

zh: 形. 好笑的、有趣的、滑稽的
example: The movie was less funny than the book.
example_zh: 这部电影没有那本书那么好笑。

example: She had to part with her fur coat.
example_zh: 她不得不舍弃她的毛皮大衣。

example: There is too much furniture in the house.
example_zh: 房子里家具太多了。

zh: 形. 更远的、此外的、更多的
example: Do you have any further questions to ask?
example_zh: 你还有什么问题要问吗？

example: Tell me about your program for the future.
example_zh: 告诉我你未来的计划。

zh: 名. 走廊、最高楼座、画廊
example: Better drop by his gallery if you have time.
example_zh: 如果有时间，最好顺便去他的画廊看看。

example: I'm glad that your team won the game.
example_zh: 我很高兴你们队赢了比赛。

zh: 名. 车库、汽车修理厂、机库
example: The car is in front of the garage.
example_zh: 车在车库前面。

example: You've been properly led up the garden path.
example_zh: 你被彻底骗了。

example: Garlic is used to improve the taste of food.
example_zh: 大蒜用来给食物提味。

example: This gas gives off a bad smell.
example_zh: 这种气体散发出难闻的气味。

example: My brother is working at a gas station.
example_zh: 我哥哥在一家加油站工作。

example: A taxi drew up at the main gate.
example_zh: 一辆出租车在大门口停了下来。

example: The geography book he put under the pillow.
example_zh: 他把那本地理书放在枕头下面。

zh: 动. 得到、获得、变成、到达
example: You ought to get to work on time.
example_zh: 你应该准时上班。

example: I need to take the bus to get back home.
example_zh: 我需要坐公共汽车回家。

example: I get dressed and have breakfast at seven.
example_zh: 我七点穿好衣服，吃早饭。

zh: 动. 健身、把身体练好
example: He runs every day to get fit.
example_zh: 他每天跑步来保持健康。

zh: 动. 结婚、结亲、成家立室
example: They are going to get married next summer.
example_zh: 他们打算明年夏天结婚。

example: to get off the bus.
example_zh: 下公共汽车。

zh: 动. 生活、融洽相处、进展
example: to get on the bus.
example_zh: 上公共汽车。

zh: 动. (使)起床、(使)起立、(使)爬上
example: to get up in the morning.
example_zh: 早上起床。

example: That child was happy to get the gift.
example_zh: 那个孩子收到礼物很高兴。

example: What do we really know about giraffes?
example_zh: 我们对长颈鹿到底了解多少？

example: You should have introduced yourself to the girl.
example_zh: 你本应该向那个女孩介绍你自己。

example: To tell the truth, she is my girlfriend.
example_zh: 说实话，她是我的女朋友。

zh: 动. 给、授予、供给、捐赠
example: If you are free, give me a hand.
example_zh: 如果你有空，帮我一把。

example: I’ll give them back to you tomorrow.
example_zh: 我明天会把它们还给你。

zh: 动. 包围、套住、按铃、成环形
example: I will give you a call tomorrow evening.
example_zh: 我明天晚上给你打电话。

zh: 形. 高兴的、喜欢的、情愿的
example: I was glad to hear of your success.
example_zh: 听到你成功的消息，我很高兴。

zh: 名. 玻璃、玻璃杯、透镜
example: I'd like to have a glass of wine.
example_zh: 我想要一杯葡萄酒。

zh: 名. 眼镜、双筒望远镜、玻璃
example: I don't have to wear glasses any more.
example_zh: 我不再需要戴眼镜了。

example: A pair of gloves is a nice gift.
example_zh: 一副手套是件不错的礼物。

zh: 动. 以…打赌、对付、忍受、去
example: I wonder how long it's going to take.
example_zh: 我想知道这要花多长时间。

example: The boy ran and ran toward the goal.
example_zh: 那个男孩跑啊跑，朝着目标跑去。

zh: 名. 山羊、替罪羊、色鬼
example: It's a goat and it is absolutely normal.
example_zh: 这是一只山羊，它完全正常。

zh: 名. 黄金、钱财、金块；形. 金的、似金的、金色的
example: Many men went west in search of gold.
example_zh: 许多男人去西部寻找金子。

zh: 形. 金的、含金的、金色的
example: He received a golden watch as a prize.
example_zh: 他得到了一块金色手表作为奖品。

example: I'd like to play a game of golf.
example_zh: 我想打一场高尔夫球。

zh: 形. 好的、优良的、上等的
example: You have a good chance to get well.
example_zh: 你很有机会康复。

example: Good afternoon, how can I help you?
example_zh: 下午好，我能帮您什么？

example: He left without so much as saying goodbye.
example_zh: 他连再见都没说就走了。

example: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to the show.
example_zh: 大家晚上好，欢迎来到演出。

zh: 形. 相貌好看的、吸引人的
example: Her brother is tall and good-looking.
example_zh: 她哥哥又高又帅。

example: Good morning, Mrs Brown. How are you today?
example_zh: 早上好，布朗太太。您今天怎么样？

example: Good night, sleep well.
example_zh: 晚安，睡个好觉。

example: Are you going out this evening?
example_zh: 你今晚要出去吗？

example: Every now and then they went shopping together.
example_zh: 他们时不时一起去购物。

example: What grade did you get on the test?
example_zh: 你考试得了多少分？

example: Add two hundred grams of sugar to the cake.
example_zh: 往蛋糕里加两百克糖。

example: The child of a child is a grandchild.
example_zh: 孩子的孩子就是孙子或孙女。

example: My grandad tells very funny stories.
example_zh: 我爷爷讲非常有趣的故事。

example: Along comes the grandmother and sees her granddaughter.
example_zh: 奶奶走过来，看见了她的孙女。

example: My grandfather is a bit hard of hearing.
example_zh: 我爷爷听力有点不好。

example: My grandma injured her leg in a fall.
example_zh: 我奶奶摔了一跤，把腿弄伤了。

example: My grandmother gave me more than I wanted.
example_zh: 我奶奶给我的比我想要的多。

zh: 名. 爷爷、老太爷、外公
example: How are Grandma and Grandpa cooking the fish?
example_zh: 爷爷奶奶正在怎么做鱼？

example: I live with my mother, brother and my grandparents.
example_zh: 我和妈妈、兄弟还有爷爷奶奶一起住。

example: Being with her grandson always makes her happy.
example_zh: 和孙子在一起总是让她很开心。

zh: 名. 奶奶、老奶奶、老婆婆
example: Granny, could you tell me one more story?
example_zh: 奶奶，你能再给我讲一个故事吗？

example: Mother sent us grapes packed in a box.
example_zh: 妈妈给我们寄来了装在盒子里的葡萄。

example: We laid the injured man on the grass.
example_zh: 我们把受伤的男子平放在草地上。

zh: 形. 大的、非常的、主要的
example: You are the great love of my life.
example_zh: 你是我一生中最爱的人。

zh: 形. 绿色的、未成熟的、新鲜的
example: The house whose roof is green is mine.
example_zh: 屋顶是绿色的那座房子是我的。

zh: 形. 灰色的；名. 灰色
example: The grey cat can't climb off the tree.
example_zh: 那只灰猫没法从树上爬下来。

zh: 形. 烤的、炙过的、有格子的
example: When was the last time you grilled meat?
example_zh: 你上次烤肉是什么时候？

example: Please tell us where there is a grocery store.
example_zh: 请告诉我们哪里有杂货店。

example: The old man fell down on the ground.
example_zh: 那位老人摔倒在地上。

example: The group is made up of six members.
example_zh: 这个小组由六名成员组成。

zh: 动. 种植、使长满、生长、变成
example: You must not smoke till you grow up.
example_zh: 你长大以前不可以吸烟。

example: What do you want to be when you grow up?
example_zh: 你长大后想做什么？

example: I guess there was some talk of that.
example_zh: 我猜有人谈论过那件事。

zh: 动. 告诉你一个好消息
example: Guess what? We are going to London next week!
example_zh: 你猜怎么着？我们下周要去伦敦！

example: There are five other guests at the hotel.
example_zh: 酒店里还有另外五位客人。

zh: 名. 高级寄宿舍、宾馆、招待所
example: We stayed in a small guest-house by the sea.
example_zh: 我们住在海边的一家小旅馆里。

zh: 名. 引导者、导游、指南
example: The guide told the kids not to take pictures.
example_zh: 导游告诉孩子们不要拍照。

example: This guidebook might be useful on your trip.
example_zh: 这本旅行指南可能对你的旅行有用。

example: The boy playing the guitar is my brother.
example_zh: 那个弹吉他的男孩是我兄弟。

example: He’s a really nice guy.
example_zh: 他人真的很好。

zh: 名. +体育馆、体育训练、体育课
example: This hotel has a gym and a swimming pool.
example_zh: 这家酒店有健身房和游泳池。

example: Young people wear their hair long these days.
example_zh: 现在年轻人留长发。

zh: 名. 一半、半场、不完全
example: We sat up half the night just talking.
example_zh: 我们熬了半夜，只是在聊天。

example: These shoes are half-price this week.
example_zh: 这双鞋这周半价。

example: There was a large crowd in the hall.
example_zh: 大厅里有一大群人。

example: You haven't washed your hands yet, have you?
example_zh: 你还没洗手，对吧？

example: This is the handbag I bought in Italy.
example_zh: 这是我在意大利买的手提包。

example: I'll always love you, no matter what happens.
example_zh: 无论发生什么，我都会永远爱你。

zh: 形. 快乐的、幸福的、愉快的
example: Though she is rich, she is not happy.
example_zh: 虽然她很有钱，但她不快乐。

example: The tram goes from the station to the harbour.
example_zh: 电车从车站开往港口。

zh: 形. 坚硬的、硬的、难的；副. 坚硬地、努力地、辛苦地
example: You must study hard and learn many things.
example_zh: 你必须努力学习，学很多东西。

example: It is too small a hat for you.
example_zh: 这顶帽子对你来说太小了。

example: I would hate to become just a housewife.
example_zh: 我不想只成为一个家庭主妇。

zh: 助. 已经；动. 有、怀有、拿
example: I don't know if I have the time.
example_zh: 我不知道我有没有时间。

zh: 助. 必须、不得不、非得
example: I have got to go home now.
example_zh: 我现在得回家了。

zh: 助. 不得不、只好、只得
example: You have to wear a uniform at my school.
example_zh: 在我学校，你必须穿校服。

example: He told me the story of his life.
example_zh: 他给我讲了他一生的故事。

example: In a crisis you must keep your head.
example_zh: 在危机中你必须保持冷静。

zh: 名. 头痛、令人头痛之事
example: The patient is always complaining of a headache.
example_zh: 这个病人总是抱怨头痛。

zh: 名. 听筒、耳机、头戴式受话器
example: When I'm using headphones I can't hear anything.
example_zh: 我用耳机时什么也听不见。

example: Tell that to the headteacher, or the acting headteacher.
example_zh: 把这件事告诉校长，或者代理校长。

example: You had better give up smoking for your health.
example_zh: 为了健康，你最好戒烟。

zh: 形. 健康的、有益健康的、卫生的
example: This boy has a strong and healthy body.
example_zh: 这个男孩身体强壮又健康。

zh: 动. 听到、倾听、听说、听见
example: I am glad to hear of your success.
example_zh: 听到你成功的消息，我很高兴。

example: I can bear this broken heart no longer.
example_zh: 我再也承受不了这颗破碎的心了。

zh: 名. 加热、供热、暖气设备
example: Can you turn the heating on?
example_zh: 你能把暖气打开吗？

zh: 形. 重的、巨大的、沉重的
example: The heavy snow kept us from going out.
example_zh: 大雪使我们无法外出。

example: The president is flying into town by helicopter.
example_zh: 总统正乘直升机飞抵城里。

example: Please say hello to your wife for me.
example_zh: 请代我向你妻子问好。

zh: 动. 帮助、帮忙、接济、有用；名. 帮忙、帮助者、补救办法
example: Call me if you need any help.
example_zh: 如果你需要任何帮助，就打电话给我。

zh: 形. 有帮助的、有益的、有用的
example: This book will be helpful to your study.
example_zh: 这本书对你的学习会有帮助。

example: You are to apologize to her for it.
example_zh: 你必须为此向她道歉。

zh: 副. 在这里、此时、这里
example: You had better stay here a little longer.
example_zh: 你最好在这里多待一会儿。

example: His story is much more interesting than hers.
example_zh: 他的故事比她的有趣得多。

example: She looks as if she's laughing to herself.
example_zh: 她看起来好像在暗自笑。

example: Hey, come on. Don't make a face.
example_zh: 嘿，来吧。别做鬼脸。

example: I won't lower myself to his level.
example_zh: 我不会把自己降到他的水平。

zh: 形. 高的、高级的、主要的
example: It is high time you started a new business.
example_zh: 你该开始做新生意了。

zh: 名. 小山、丘陵、小土堆
example: That church on the hill is very old.
example_zh: 山上的那座教堂很古老。

example: I think you had better call on him.
example_zh: 我觉得你最好去拜访他。

example: He has said so himself to my knowledge.
example_zh: 据我所知，他自己这么说过。

example: My brother loves hip hop music.
example_zh: 我哥哥喜欢嘻哈音乐。

example: A happy hippo is swimming in the lake.
example_zh: 一只快乐的河马在湖里游泳。

example: While eating a pizza he was annoying his sister.
example_zh: 他一边吃披萨，一边惹他姐姐生气。

example: We are very interested in the history.
example_zh: 我们对历史很感兴趣。

zh: 动. 打、打击、碰撞、打中
example: We hit the right road in the dark.
example_zh: 我们在黑暗中走对了路。

example: Do you have a hobby - for example, painting?
example_zh: 你有爱好吗——比如画画？

example: Field hockey is not very popular in China.
example_zh: 曲棍球在中国不太受欢迎。

zh: 动. 保存、握住、拿住、支持
example: You've got to learn to hold your tongue.
example_zh: 你得学会管住自己的嘴。

example: You are in need of a holiday.
example_zh: 你需要一个假期。

zh: 名. 家、避难所、故乡；副. 在家、在本国、打中目标地
example: You'd better go home as soon as possible.
example_zh: 你最好尽快回家。

zh: 名. 家庭作业、家里做的工作
example: I have a lot of homework to do.
example_zh: 我有很多作业要做。

example: Sorry honey, I'm still stuck at the office.
example_zh: 对不起，亲爱的，我还在办公室脱不开身。

example: Yanni wore a dark hoodie covering his head.
example_zh: 雅尼穿着一件深色连帽衫，帽子遮住了他的头。

example: I hope that you will get well soon.
example_zh: 我希望你早日康复。

zh: 形. 可怕的、遭透的、极讨厌的
example: It was horrible to hear about the crime.
example_zh: 听到那起犯罪事件，真可怕。

example: She drew back in horror at the sight.
example_zh: 看到那景象，她惊恐地往后退。

example: London was a city built for the horse.
example_zh: 伦敦曾是一座为马而建的城市。

example: I was in the hospital for a week.
example_zh: 我在医院住了一周。

zh: 形. 热的、热心的、辣的
example: I understand it's going to get hot again.
example_zh: 我知道天气又要变热了。

example: We stayed at a hotel by the lake.
example_zh: 我们住在湖边的一家旅馆。

example: How many hours of sleep do you need?
example_zh: 你需要睡几个小时？

example: I wish I could live near your house.
example_zh: 我希望我能住在你家附近。

example: I'm a housewife and a mother of three.
example_zh: 我是家庭主妇，也是三个孩子的母亲。

example: What... you still don't know how to drive?
example_zh: 什么……你还不会开车？

zh: 副. 然而、无论如何、究竟怎样
example: However tired I may be, I must work.
example_zh: 不管我多累，我都必须工作。

zh: 形. 极大的、巨大的、无限的
example: The huge building seemed to touch the sky.
example_zh: 那座巨大的建筑似乎碰到了天空。

zh: 形. 饥饿的、荒年的、渴望的
example: You must be hungry after school is over.
example_zh: 放学后你一定饿了。

zh: 动. 急派、催促、匆忙、赶快
example: I think we'll make it if we hurry.
example_zh: 我想如果我们快点，就能赶到。

zh: 动. 伤害、(使)伤心、危害
example: Have I said something to hurt your feelings?
example_zh: 我是不是说了什么让你难过的话？

zh: 名. 丈夫、管理人、节俭的人
example: I have yet to find a perfect husband.
example_zh: 我还没有找到完美的丈夫。

example: I just don't know what to say.
example_zh: 我只是不知道该说什么。

example: There is nothing like summer and ice cream.
example_zh: 没有什么比夏天和冰淇淋更好的了。

example: I would like a chocolate ice cream, please.
example_zh: 请给我一个巧克力冰淇淋。

example: We go ice skating every winter.
example_zh: 我们每年冬天都去滑冰。

zh: 名. 遗传素质、本能冲动
example: I'm going to need to see some ID.
example_zh: 我需要看一下身份证件。

example: Please show your ID card at the door.
example_zh: 请在门口出示你的身份证。

example: Your idea seems to be similar to mine.
example_zh: 你的想法似乎和我的相似。

zh: 名. 识别、身份证明、认同
example: The driver’s license can serve as photo identification.
example_zh: 驾照可以作为带照片的身份证明。

zh: 连. 如果、是否、无论何时
example: I don't know if I still have it.
example_zh: 我不知道我是否还留着它。

zh: 形. 生病的、邪恶的、不吉利的
example: Don't speak ill of others behind their back.
example_zh: 不要在背后说别人的坏话。

zh: 副. 直接地、立刻、立即
example: She promised to look into the matter immediately.
example_zh: 她答应立即调查这件事。

zh: 形. 重要的、有地位的、大量的
example: It's important for us to win the game.
example_zh: 对我们来说，赢得比赛很重要。

zh: 形. 不可能的、难以置信的、令人无法忍受的
example: It is impossible for you to do so.
example_zh: 你不可能这样做。

zh: 动. 改良、提高…的价值、改善、变得更好
example: You can improve your English if you try.
example_zh: 如果你努力，你的英语可以提高。

zh: 副. 进入、朝里、在里面；介. 在…期间、在…之内、处于…之中
example: You're in better shape than I am.
example_zh: 你的身体状态比我好。

zh: 动. 包括、把…算入、包住
example: The price does not include the case.
example_zh: 价格不包括盒子。

example: I read several books last week, including yours.
example_zh: 我上周读了几本书，包括你的。

example: Don't stay indoors because it is cold outside.
example_zh: 不要因为外面冷就待在室内。

example: It was raining hard, so we played indoors.
example_zh: 雨下得很大，所以我们在室内玩。

example: Information is given in English at every airport.
example_zh: 每个机场都用英语提供信息。

example: The bus stops in front of the school.
example_zh: 公交车停在学校前面。

example: This ingredient is used in traditional Chinese medicine.
example_zh: 这种成分用于中药。

example: What do you call this insect in English?
example_zh: 这种昆虫用英语怎么说？

zh: 副. 在里面；介. 在…之内
example: I looked round the inside of the house.
example_zh: 我在房子里面四处看了看。

example: Let's go by train instead of by bus.
example_zh: 我们坐火车去，不坐公共汽车。

example: I'd like to have tea instead of coffee.
example_zh: 我想喝茶，不喝咖啡。

example: I will do it according to your instructions.
example_zh: 我会按照你的指示做。

example: You can play a musical instrument, can't you?
example_zh: 你会演奏乐器，对吧？

example: The press is interested in his private life.
example_zh: 媒体对他的私生活感兴趣。

example: The movie was interesting, as I had expected.
example_zh: 这部电影很有趣，正如我所料。

example: The problem began to assume an international character.
example_zh: 这个问题开始具有国际性。

zh: 名. 因特网、国际互连网、网际网络
example: Our company makes use of the Internet.
example_zh: 我们公司使用互联网。

zh: 介. 进入…之内、朝…、深入…之中
example: You must take his age into account.
example_zh: 你必须考虑到他的年龄。

example: Children were apt to invent their own games.
example_zh: 孩子们常常自己编游戏。

zh: 名. 发明、创作能力、虚构的故事
example: We have a good opinion of your invention.
example_zh: 我们对你的发明评价很高。

example: You have a standing invitation to join us.
example_zh: 我们随时欢迎你加入。

example: You may invite any person you like.
example_zh: 你可以邀请任何你喜欢的人。

zh: 名. 岛、岛屿、孤立地区
example: We arrived on the island two days later.
example_zh: 两天后我们到达了那座岛。

example: It's not much of a surprise, is it?
example_zh: 这算不上什么惊喜，对吧？

example: The summer drew near to its end.
example_zh: 夏天接近尾声了。

example: Strange to say, the door opened of itself.
example_zh: 说来奇怪，门自己开了。

example: There was a black jacket on the book.
example_zh: 书上放着一件黑色夹克。

zh: 名. 果酱、拥塞之物、堵塞
example: Take the jam down from the top shelf.
example_zh: 把果酱从最上层的架子上拿下来。

example: The first month of the year is January.
example_zh: 一年中的第一个月是一月。

example: Modern jazz is not to my taste.
example_zh: 现代爵士乐不合我的口味。

example: Made in Italy, these jeans were very expensive.
example_zh: 这条牛仔裤是意大利制造的，非常贵。

zh: 名. 水母、海蜇、意志薄弱的人
example: There are jellyfish out there today, so watch out.
example_zh: 今天外面有水母，所以要小心。

zh: 名. 宝石、贵重饰物、珠宝
example: Why would Layla wear jewellery on the beach?
example_zh: 莱拉为什么要在海滩上戴首饰呢？

example: You must share your jobs with others.
example_zh: 你必须和别人分担你的工作。

zh: 动. 连接、结合、参加、加入
example: All you have to do is to join us.
example_zh: 你只要加入我们就行了。

zh: 名. 新闻记者、从事新闻杂志业的人
example: The journalist was calm even in an emergency.
example_zh: 那位记者即使在紧急情况下也很冷静。

example: I can't afford the time for a journey.
example_zh: 我抽不出时间去旅行。

example: He drank orange juice out of a bottle.
example_zh: 他从瓶子里喝橙汁。

example: I'm taking a vacation from July 20 through August 8.
example_zh: 我从7月20日到8月8日休假。

zh: 动. 跳跃、跃过、突升、跳
example: I was too glad not to jump up.
example_zh: 我高兴得跳了起来。

example: You've got your jumper on inside out!
example_zh: 你的套头衫穿反了！

example: My sister is having a baby in June.
example_zh: 我姐姐六月要生孩子了。

example: I’ve just seen Tom.
example_zh: 我刚看见汤姆。

example: I was tried in a kangaroo court.
example_zh: 我在一个私设法庭受审。

zh: 动. 保持、保存、遵守、继续不断
example: May I keep this?
example_zh: 我可以留着这个吗？

example: This is the key to my house.
example_zh: 这是我家的钥匙。

example: I play the keyboard in a band.
example_zh: 我在乐队里弹键盘。

zh: 名. 踢、反冲、后座力；动. 踢、反冲、反抗
example: Kick with your legs straight to go forward.
example_zh: 双腿伸直踢水向前。

example: The kids are playing in the garden.
example_zh: 孩子们正在花园里玩。

example: This bag weighs about one kilogramme.
example_zh: 这个包大约重一公斤。

example: The school is two kilometres from my house.
example_zh: 学校离我家两公里。

zh: 形. 亲切的、仁慈的、和蔼的；名. 种类、性质、方式
example: That’s very kind of you.
example_zh: 你真好。

example: The king turned out to be naked.
example_zh: 原来国王没穿衣服。

zh: 名. 吻；动. 吻、接吻
example: The mother kissed her baby on the lips.
example_zh: 妈妈亲了宝宝的嘴唇。

zh: 名. 装备、工具箱、成套工具
example: It's a very clever piece of kit.
example_zh: 这是一件非常巧妙的装备。

example: There is a kitchen garden behind my house.
example_zh: 我家后面有一个菜园。

zh: 名. 风筝、筝帆、空头支票
example: There is a kite flying above the tree.
example_zh: 树的上方有一只风筝在飞。

example: The kitten couldn't get down from the tree.
example_zh: 小猫没法从树上下来。

example: Put that knife down. You're making me nervous.
example_zh: 把那把刀放下。你让我很紧张。

example: I didn't know where it came from.
example_zh: 我不知道它是从哪里来的。

example: I would often go fishing in the lake.
example_zh: 我过去常常去湖里钓鱼。

example: The lamp went out, and all was black.
example_zh: 灯灭了，一片漆黑。

example: Few people can speak a foreign language perfectly.
example_zh: 很少有人能完美地说一门外语。

example: I do my homework on my laptop.
example_zh: 我用笔记本电脑做作业。

zh: 形. 大的、大量的、宽大的
example: There is a large house on the hill.
example_zh: 山上有一座大房子。

zh: 形. 最后的、末尾的、最近的
example: He changed a lot since the last time.
example_zh: 和上次相比，他变了很多。

zh: 副. 很晚、很迟、晚；形. 迟的、晚的、已故的
example: The train is going to be late.
example_zh: 火车要晚点了。

example: I’ll see you later.
example_zh: 待会儿见。

example: He will arrive by eight at the latest.
example_zh: 他最晚八点到。

zh: 动. 以笑表示、笑、大笑
example: Don't laugh at him for making a mistake.
example_zh: 不要因为他犯错误就嘲笑他。

zh: 形. 懒惰的、怠惰的、缓慢的
example: Stop being lazy and find something to do.
example_zh: 别偷懒了，找点事做。

zh: 动. 学习、认识到、得知
example: I thought you liked to learn new things.
example_zh: 我以为你喜欢学新东西。

example: The trip will take at least five days.
example_zh: 这次旅行至少要五天。

zh: 名. 皮革、皮制品、马镫的皮带；形. 皮革的、皮制的
example: This steak is as tough as shoe leather.
example_zh: 这块牛排硬得像鞋皮。

zh: 动. 离开、剩下、遗忘、出发
example: I will have left here before you return.
example_zh: 在你回来之前，我就会离开这里了。

zh: 形. 左边的、左倾的、左侧的；副. 在左面；名. 左、左面、左派
example: Go to the left.
example_zh: 往左走。

example: The shop is on the left-hand side of the street.
example_zh: 商店在街道的左侧。

example: A ball hit her on the right leg.
example_zh: 一个球打中了她的右腿。

zh: 名. 柠檬、柠檬树、柠檬色
example: I feel better when I drink hot lemon juice.
example_zh: 我喝热柠檬汁时感觉好一些。

example: The police shut down Tom’s lemonade stand.
example_zh: 警察关闭了汤姆的柠檬水摊。

zh: 动. 借、贷款给、增添、贷款
example: I will lend you whatever book you need.
example_zh: 你需要什么书，我就借给你什么书。

example: The length of the lesson/journey was 50 minutes.
example_zh: 这节课/这段路程长达50分钟。

example: Mr Young has no less than six cars.
example_zh: 杨先生至少有六辆车。

example: Did you try to review the English lessons?
example_zh: 你试着复习英语课了吗？

zh: 动. 让、假设、出租、被承包
example: Let’s go to the beach.
example_zh: 我们去海滩吧。

example: You shouldn't read people's private letters without permission.
example_zh: 你不应该未经允许读别人的私人信件。

example: The level of the school is high.
example_zh: 这所学校的水平很高。

example: Tomorrow, I'm going to study at the library.
example_zh: 明天我要在图书馆学习。

zh: 名. 执照、许可证、特许
example: A car licence can be held from age 18.
example_zh: 从18岁起就可以持有汽车驾照。

example: I want to lie down for a few minutes.
example_zh: 我想躺几分钟。

example: Are you saying my life is in danger?
example_zh: 你是说我的生命有危险吗？

example: Take the lift to the third floor.
example_zh: 乘电梯到三楼。

zh: 名. 光、光亮、灯；形. 轻的、少量的、轻微的
example: Please turn out the lights when you leave.
example_zh: 你离开时请关灯。

zh: 副. 可能；介. 象、如同；动. 喜欢、愿意、想、希望
example: What’s the weather like?
example_zh: 天气怎么样？

example: You're giving me the same old line.
example_zh: 你又在对我说同样的老话。

example: Click on the link.
example_zh: 点击链接。

zh: 名. 狮子、狮子(星)座、国际狮子会会员
example: The lion ate the rabbit in one bite.
example_zh: 狮子一口吃掉了兔子。

zh: 名. 目录、名单、明细表
example: Don't leave my name out of your list.
example_zh: 别把我的名字从你的名单里漏掉。

example: I listen to music every evening.
example_zh: 我每天晚上听音乐。

example: They each drank half a litre of wine.
example_zh: 他们每人喝了半升葡萄酒。

zh: 形. 小的、很少的、幼小的
example: You should not think little of this result.
example_zh: 你不应该小看这个结果。

zh: 动. 过着、度过、经历、活
example: I can't live that kind of life.
example_zh: 我过不了那种生活。

example: We watch television in the living room.
example_zh: 我们在客厅看电视。

example: The lizard escaped from under the rock.
example_zh: 蜥蜴从岩石下面逃走了。

zh: 形. 地方性的、当地的、局部的
example: Our children all go to the local school.
example_zh: 我们的孩子都上当地的学校。

zh: 形. 长的、长久的、冗长的
example: Ten years is a long time to wait.
example_zh: 等十年是很长的时间。

zh: 动. 打量、看上去与…一样、以眼色(或脸色)显示、看
example: You must not look upon him as great.
example_zh: 你不能把他看作很伟大。

example: My sister looks after the baby on Fridays.
example_zh: 我姐姐每周五照看宝宝。

example: Look at the board, please.
example_zh: 请看黑板。

example: I am looking for my keys.
example_zh: 我在找我的钥匙。

example: Look out – it’s going to fall!
example_zh: 小心——它要掉下来了！

example: I was almost run over by a lorry.
example_zh: 我差点被一辆卡车撞到。

zh: 动. 遗失、损失、丢失、受损失
example: We lost the game.
example_zh: 我们输了比赛。

zh: 形. 失去的、遗失的、迷惑的
example: You should not give him up for lost.
example_zh: 你不应该认为他失踪了而放弃他。

example: a lot of homework.
example_zh: 很多家庭作业。

zh: 形. 大声的、不断的、喧吵的
example: I can't put up with that loud noise.
example_zh: 我受不了那么大的噪音。

zh: 名. 爱、恋爱、爱情；动. 爱、爱好、爱慕
example: I love you more than you love me.
example_zh: 我爱你胜过你爱我。

example: The weather was lovely when I left home.
example_zh: 我离家时天气很好。

zh: 形. 低的、消沉的、低等的
example: Lots of low trees grow on the hill.
example_zh: 山上长着许多矮树。

example: You're in luck. The plane is on time.
example_zh: 你运气真好。飞机准点。

zh: 副. 幸运地、幸亏、侥幸
example: Luckily, he was on time for the train.
example_zh: 幸运的是，他准时赶上了火车。

zh: 形. 幸运的、吉祥的、好运的
example: How lucky I am to meet you here!
example_zh: 我在这里遇到你，真幸运！

example: She lent them a hand with their luggage.
example_zh: 她帮他们搬行李。

example: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late for lunch.
example_zh: 快点，不然你吃午饭要迟到了。

example: We should get to Chicago by lunchtime.
example_zh: 我们应当在午饭前到达芝加哥。

zh: 名. 机器、机械装置、机构
example: The machine has some of its parts missing.
example_zh: 这台机器少了一些零件。

zh: 形. 疯狂的、发疯的、生气的
example: He was so sad that he almost went mad.
example_zh: 他太伤心了，几乎要发疯了。

example: It is foolish to read such a magazine.
example_zh: 读这样的杂志是愚蠢的。

example: Our letters probably crossed in the mail.
example_zh: 我们的信可能在邮寄途中互相错过了。

zh: 名. 主帆、主要课程、主菜
example: For the main course I had chicken and rice.
example_zh: 主菜我吃了鸡肉和米饭。

zh: 动. 制造、安排、创造、开始
example: Stop it! You're making her feel uncomfortable!
example_zh: 住手！你让她感到不舒服了！

example: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
example_zh: 离开前一定要锁门。

example: She never wears make-up to school.
example_zh: 她从不在去学校时化妆。

example: You are the man I've been looking for.
example_zh: 你就是我一直在找的那个人。

zh: 名. 经理、管理员、管理器
example: I'd like to talk to the hotel manager.
example_zh: 我想和酒店经理谈谈。

example: I am looking for a mango to eat.
example_zh: 我在找一个芒果吃。

example: There are many words that I don't understand.
example_zh: 有很多词我不懂。

zh: 名. 地图、天体图、映像
example: Please give me a map of the town.
example_zh: 请给我一张城镇地图。

example: March 15 will be my last day of school.
example_zh: 3月15日将是我在学校的最后一天。

example: Your guess is entirely off the mark.
example_zh: 你的猜测完全不对。

example: London developed into the general market of Europe.
example_zh: 伦敦发展成了欧洲的综合性市场。

example: It won't be long before they get married.
example_zh: 用不了多久他们就会结婚。

example: No one can match her in speaking French.
example_zh: 在说法语方面没人能比得上她。

example: Maths is my favourite subject at school.
example_zh: 数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

zh: 名. 事件、物质、原因；动. 有关系
example: It doesn’t matter.
example_zh: 没关系。

example: You may as well prepare for your examination.
example_zh: 你不妨为考试做准备。

example: Maybe they will come and maybe they won't.
example_zh: 也许他们会来，也许不会。

example: It would take forever for me to explain everything.
example_zh: 我要把所有事情解释清楚，得花很长时间。

example: We're going out for a meal on Friday.
example_zh: 我们星期五要出去吃饭。

zh: 动. 意谓、想要、意欲、用意
example: Education means something more than going to school.
example_zh: 教育不只是上学。

example: None of the meat was fit to eat.
example_zh: 那些肉都不能吃。

example: I'll have a mechanic check the car out.
example_zh: 我会请修理工检查一下这辆车。

example: I'll wait here until my medicine is ready.
example_zh: 我会在这里等我的药准备好。

zh: 动. 遇见、引见、认识、相遇
example: It's been ten years since we last met.
example_zh: 我们上次见面到现在已经十年了。

example: I look forward to meeting you again soon.
example_zh: 我期待很快再次见到你。

example: The melon smells sweet and tastes very nice.
example_zh: 这个瓜闻起来很甜，味道也很好。

example: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.
example_zh: 每个成员每月要付一万日元。

zh: 名. 记忆、记忆力、回忆、内存
example: My computer has 100GB of memory.
example_zh: 我的电脑有100GB内存。

zh: 名. 菜单、(功能)选择单
example: Choose whatever dish you want from the menu.
example_zh: 从菜单上选你想要的任何菜。

zh: 名. 消息、通讯、讯息；动. 通知、通报、报告、报信
example: I have a message for you from her.
example_zh: 我有她给你的一个消息。

zh: 名. 金属、金属制品、合金；形. 金属制的
example: Iron is a metal with many uses.
example_zh: 铁是一种有很多用途的金属。

example: It's a thirty-metre-long boat.
example_zh: 这是一艘三十米长的船。

example: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.
example_zh: 不知什么原因，麦克风刚才坏了。

example: It is midday. The men are eating lunch.
example_zh: 现在是中午。男人们正在吃午饭。

example: In the middle of the lake lies the island.
example_zh: 湖中间有一座岛。

example: The party came to an end at midnight.
example_zh: 派对在午夜结束了。

example: We were worried we might miss the train.
example_zh: 我们担心可能赶不上火车。

example: You can see for miles from the roof.
example_zh: 从屋顶上能看到好几英里远。

example: The doctor advised me to drink more milk.
example_zh: 医生建议我多喝牛奶。

example: There are millions of stars in the universe.
example_zh: 宇宙中有数百万颗星星。

zh: 动. 注意、留意、专心于、介意
example: Do you mind if I close the window?
example_zh: 我关窗户你介意吗？

example: Your room is twice the size of mine.
example_zh: 你的房间是我的两倍大。

zh: 名. na. 矿泉水、矿质水
example: Can I have a bottle of mineral water?
example_zh: 我可以要一瓶矿泉水吗？

example: The temperature outside is minus four.
example_zh: 外面的温度是零下四度。

example: The school is only a five-minute walk.
example_zh: 学校只有五分钟的步行路程。

example: Its surface was as flat as a mirror.
example_zh: 它的表面像镜子一样平。

example: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.
example_zh: 快点，不然你会赶不上火车。

example: The last page of this book is missing.
example_zh: 这本书的最后一页不见了。

example: You made the same mistake as last time.
example_zh: 你犯了和上次一样的错误。

zh: 动. 使混合、弄混、使结合、相混合
example: I don't like to mix business with pleasure.
example_zh: 我不喜欢把工作和娱乐混在一起。

example: My mobile phone is in my bag.
example_zh: 我的手机在包里。

zh: 名. 模型、模范、模特儿
example: Those new model cars are on the market.
example_zh: 那些新款汽车已经上市了。

example: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.
example_zh: 现代科技让我们的生活更舒适。

example: I asked Mom to get some for you.
example_zh: 我让妈妈给你拿了一些。

example: I’m in England at the moment.
example_zh: 我现在在英国。

example: The museum is open from Monday to Friday.
example_zh: 博物馆周一到周五开放。

zh: 名. 金钱、一笔款、财富
example: Thanks to you, I spent all my money.
example_zh: 因为你，我花光了所有的钱。

example: He climbed up the tree like a monkey.
example_zh: 他像猴子一样爬上了树。

example: I've been going out with her for months.
example_zh: 我和她交往好几个月了。

zh: 形. 每月的、每月一次的
example: His monthly salary is no less than 500,000 yen.
example_zh: 他的月薪不少于50万日元。

example: The moon came out from behind the clouds.
example_zh: 月亮从云后面出来了。

zh: 形. 多的、程度较大的、更大的；副. 多、更多、进一步
example: You should pay more attention to what he says.
example_zh: 你应该多注意他说的话。

example: We agreed to start early the next morning.
example_zh: 我们同意第二天一早就开始。

zh: 形. 大多数的、几乎全部的、最多的；副. 最、最多、极其
example: What you need the most now is courage.
example_zh: 你现在最需要的是勇气。
